source.text: וַיְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵי֙ מ֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַֽיִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּיהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה־לָּ֧נוּ אֶל־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֛י בַּתְּחִלָּ֖ה לְהִלָּ֥חֶם בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after [the] death of Joshua, and asked [the] sons of Israel of Yahweh, saying, Who will go up for us against the Canaanite[s] at the first, to fight against him?

en.L: And it was after the death of Joshua, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, saying, "Who will go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?"
en.B: After Joshua died, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Which of us should go up first to fight against the Canaanites?"
en.R: After Joshua died, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} asked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for guidance. "Which tribe should go first to attack the Canaanites?" they asked.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya kifo cha Yoshua, wana wa Israeli wakamwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakisema, "Ni nani atakayetupandia kwanza dhidi ya Wakanaani, ili kupigana nao?"
sw.B: Baada ya Yoshua kufa, Waisraeli walimwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Ni nani kati yetu atakayepanda kwanza kupigana na Wakanaani?"
sw.R: Yoshua alipokwisha kufa, Waisraeli walimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awaongoze. Wakamwuliza, "Ni kabila gani litangulie kwenda kuwashambulia Wakanaani?"

es.L: Y sucedió después de la muerte de Josué, que los hijos de Israel consultaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, diciendo: «¿Quién subirá por nosotros contra los cananeos primero, para pelear contra ellos?»
es.B: Después de la muerte de Josué, los israelitas consultaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «¿Quién de nosotros debe subir primero a pelear contra los cananeos?»
es.R: Después de que murió Josué, los israelitas le pidieron dirección {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. «¿Qué tribu debe ir primero a atacar a los cananeos?», le preguntaron.

fr.L: Et il arriva, après la mort de Josué, [que] les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël interrogèrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, en disant : « Qui montera pour nous contre les Cananéens en premier, pour combattre contre eux ? »
fr.B: Après la mort de Josué, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} demandèrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Lequel d’entre nous doit monter le premier combattre les Cananéens ? »
fr.R: Après la mort de Josué, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont demandé {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de les guider. Ils lui ont demandé : « Quelle tribu doit partir la première pour attaquer les Cananéens ? »

vi.L: Và xảy ra sau khi Giô-suê chết, con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rằng: "Ai sẽ đi lên trước tiên cho chúng con để đánh người Ca-na-an?"
vi.B: Sau khi Giô-suê qua đời, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Ai trong chúng con phải đi lên trước để đánh người Ca-na-an?"
vi.R: Sau khi Giô-suê qua đời, dân Y-sơ-ra-ên cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để biết phải làm gì. Họ hỏi: "Chi tộc nào phải đi trước để tấn công người Ca-na-an?"

ko.L: 그리고 여호수아가 죽은 뒤에 이스라엘 자손이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 말했다. "누가 우리를 위하여 먼저 가나안 사람들에게로 올라가서 그들과 싸우겠습니까?"
ko.B: 여호수아가 죽은 뒤에 이스라엘 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈었다. "우리 가운데 누가 먼저 올라가서 가나안 사람들과 싸워야 합니까?"
ko.R: 여호수아가 죽은 뒤에 이스라엘 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 어떻게 해야 할지 여쭈었다. "어느 지파가 먼저 가서 가나안 사람들을 쳐야 합니까?"

pt.L: E aconteceu, depois da morte de Josué, que os filhos de Israel consultaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, dizendo: "Quem subirá por nós primeiro contra os cananeus, para lutar contra eles?"
pt.B: Depois que Josué morreu, os israelitas consultaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: "Qual de nós deve subir primeiro para lutar contra os cananeus?"
pt.R: Depois que Josué morreu, os israelitas pediram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} que os orientasse. "Qual tribo deve ir primeiro atacar os cananeus?", eles perguntaram.

am.L: ከኢያሱም ሞት በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች፦ «ከነዓናውያንን እንወጋቸው ዘንድ ማን አስቀድሞ ይውጣልን?» ብለው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ጠየቁ።
am.B: ኢያሱ ከሞተ በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች፦ «ከነዓናውያንን ለመውጋት ከእኛ መካከል አስቀድሞ የሚወጣው ማን ይሁን?» ብለው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ጠየቁ።
am.R: ኢያሱ ከሞተ በኋላ እስራኤላውያን ምን ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ጠየቁ። «ከነዓናውያንን ለመውጋት ቀድሞ የሚሄደው የትኛው ነገድ ይሁን?» አሉ።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि यहोशू की मृत्यु के बाद {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पूछा, "कनानियों से लड़ने के लिए हमारी ओर से पहले उन पर कौन चढ़ाई करेगा?"
hi.B: यहोशू की मृत्यु के बाद इस्राएलियों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से पूछा, "हममें से कौन पहले कनानियों से लड़ने के लिए चढ़ाई करे?"
hi.R: यहोशू के मरने के बाद इस्राएलियों ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से मार्गदर्शन माँगा। "कनानियों पर हमला करने के लिए पहले कौन-सा गोत्र जाए?" उन्होंने पूछा।

ru.L: И было после смерти Иисуса Навина: и вопросили {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}} {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, говоря: «Кто поднимется у нас первым против хананеев, чтобы сражаться с ними?»
ru.B: После смерти Иисуса Навина израильтяне спросили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}: «Кто из нас должен первым выступить против хананеев и сразиться с ними?»
ru.R: Когда Иисус Навин умер, израильтяне спросили {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, как им поступить. «Какое колено должно первым напасть на хананеев?» — спрашивали они.

ja.L: そしてヨシュアの死の後のことである。イスラエルの子らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に伺って言った。「わたしたちのために、だれが最初にカナン人に向かって上って行き、彼らと戦うのでしょうか？」
ja.B: ヨシュアが死んだ後、イスラエルの人々は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に問うた。「わたしたちのうち、だれが最初に上って行って、カナン人と戦うべきでしょうか？」
ja.R: ヨシュアが死んだ後、イスラエルの人々は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に教えを求めました。「どの部族が最初にカナン人を攻めに行けばよいでしょうか？」と彼らは尋ねました。

uk.L: І сталося після смерті Ісуса Навина, що {{gender:нащадки Ізраїля|сини Ізраїля}} питали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, кажучи: «Хто з нас піде першим проти ханаанеїв, щоб воювати з ними?»
uk.B: Після смерті Ісуса Навина ізраїльтяни запитали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}: «Хто з нас має першим піти воювати проти ханаанеїв?»
uk.R: Після смерті Ісуса Навина ізраїльтяни звернулися до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} по пораду. «Яке племʼя має першим піти в наступ на ханаанеїв?» — питали вони.

decisions.choice: after the death of Joshua: the book begins where the book of Joshua ends
decisions.reason: Joshua's death and burial are told in Joshua 24:29-31. The book of Joshua opened with the same kind of words, "after the death of Moses" (Joshua 1:1), and Judges now opens the next stage in the same way: the tribes must go on without the leader who brought them into the land. Judges 2:6-10 steps back and tells Joshua's death again, to begin the account of the generations that followed. Some events in this chapter are also told in Joshua (the taking of Hebron and Debir, Joshua 15:13-19), so the chapter may gather the tribes' campaigns as a summary rather than keep strict order of time.

decisions.choice: asked of the LORD: sought God's answer, probably through the priest
decisions.reason: To "ask of the LORD" is to seek a decision from God. In Israel this was done through the priest, who carried the Urim and Thummim for this purpose (Numbers 27:21). The same question is asked in 20:18, at the other end of the book, where the tribes fight one of their own.

decisions.choice: the Canaanites: the peoples of the land as a whole
decisions.reason: "The Canaanite" is singular in the Hebrew, a name for the people of the land taken together, as in verses 3 and 4 where it stands beside other peoples. Here it means all who still held the land Israel was to take.

decisions.choice: who will go up for us first: which tribe is to lead the attack
decisions.reason: The question is not who should fight but who should begin, leading the rest. The answer in verse 2 names one tribe, Judah.

decisions.choice: for guidance; Which tribe
decisions.reason: Readable says what asking the LORD meant (m2) and makes plain that the question is about which tribe should lead, since the answer is a tribe (verse 2).

decisions.choice: the divine name as "el SEÑOR" in capitals by default ("El SEÑOR" at a sentence start, "del SEÑOR", "al SEÑOR"), with "Yahvé" under the divine name setting
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as in the Pentateuch: the divine name is written "el SEÑOR" in capitals, like the English "the LORD", and the divine name setting gives "Yahvé". The span takes in the article and its contraction ("del", "al"), since "Yahvé" takes no article. "Jehová", the Reina-Valera form, is the alternative a Spanish reviewer may prefer.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as in the Pentateuch: Spanish "hijos" already takes in daughters, so the Literal "los hijos de Israel" (and "los hijos de Judá", "de Benjamín", "de Dan") is inclusive as it stands and needs no setting; Balanced and Readable say "los israelitas" or "la gente de", as the English does.

decisions.choice: narration in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("interrogèrent", "demandèrent") and the passé composé at Readable ("ont demandé"); speech in the tenses of speech at every level
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges 1-10, as the French style guide and the terms note for Joshua, Judges and Ruth set for narrative: the passé simple is the tense of written narrative in French and suits a careful public reading, while the passé composé is how French is spoken and read in school today, so Readable uses it. What characters say keeps the tenses of speech ("je vous ai fait monter d'Égypte", 2:1).

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" for YHWH, with "Yahvé" as the reader setting; the span takes in the article and its contraction
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges 1-10, as in the Pentateuch: the divine name is "le SEIGNEUR" in capitals by default, like the English "the LORD", with "Yahvé" as the reader setting ("du SEIGNEUR" / "de Yahvé", "au SEIGNEUR" / "à Yahvé"). "L'Éternel", the name used in the Segond tradition, is the alternative a reviewer may prefer; plain "le Seigneur" would hide that the name is used.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" (L) and "이스라엘 백성" (B, R) for "the sons of Israel", with no gender setting
alternatives: "이스라엘의 아들들" with a gender setting, as the English has
decisions.reason: The Korean words already mean the whole people, men and women, as in Genesis, so there are not two ways of saying it for a setting to choose between. The people ask God in the formal polite style (합쇼체), as in prayer. This holds for the whole block.

decisions.choice: "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "con cháu" (descendants) already includes men and women, so Vietnamese needs no gender setting here, and it is the Literal form of the Pentateuch; Balanced and Readable say "the people of Israel", as the English says "the Israelites".

decisions.choice: Israel prays to the LORD as "chúng con" (we, as children)
decisions.reason: People speaking to God use "con" for themselves, as in Genesis and Psalms.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L), os israelitas (B, R), with no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md and Joshua 1:2 set it in Portuguese: "filhos" already takes in daughters, and "os israelitas" names the whole people, so there is no second wording for the gender setting to offer. The same for "os filhos de Judá", "de Benjamim", "de Dã" (L) and "o povo de ..." or "os homens de ..." (B, R), as the English says.

decisions.choice: consultaram o SENHOR (L, B); pediram ao SENHOR que os orientasse (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 20:18, 23, 27): to ask of the LORD is to seek his decision (m2), and "consultar" says that in Portuguese, where "perguntaram ao SENHOR" would sound like an ordinary question. Readable says what the asking was for, as the English adds "for guidance".

decisions.choice: For the whole of Judges: the divine name is "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" at every level (with a prefix or suffix, the whole word in each option); "the LORD your God" puts the name second ("አምላካችሁ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}", 3:7 "አምላካቸው"); Elohim standing alone for the one God is "እግዚአብሔር" (1:7; 4:23); "the God of Israel" is "የእስራኤል አምላክ"; gods are "አማልክት". The sons of Israel are "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (Literal, Balanced) and "እስራኤላውያን" (Readable), with no gender span, since "ልጆች" already includes daughters; likewise "the sons of Judah, of Benjamin, of Dan" are "የይሁዳ ልጆች" (Literal) and "የይሁዳ ሰዎች" (Balanced, Readable). The leaders of the book (shofetim) are "መሳፍንት", one "መስፍን" (Literal, Balanced), "መሪዎች" (Readable); "he judged Israel" is "እስራኤልን ዳኘ" (Literal, Balanced), "እስራኤልን መራ" (Readable). To dispossess or drive out (yarash in the causative) is "አስወጣ" at every level, as in Numbers and Deuteronomy; to take possession is "ወረሰ".
decisions.reason: So that Judges reads with Genesis to Joshua. "ዳኞች" now means court judges; "መሳፍንት" is the Amharic name of these leaders and of the book, and Readable says what they were. Several agents draft the chapters of Judges at once, so the shared words are set here once for the whole book.

decisions.choice: The cycle that runs through the book (2:11-19; 3:7-15; 4:1-3; 6:1-7 and on) keeps one wording for each part. Did evil: "የእስራኤል ልጆች {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ዓይን ክፉ የሆነውን አደረጉ" (Literal), "... {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ክፉ የሆነውን አደረጉ" (Balanced), "እስራኤላውያን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ክፉ ነው የሚለውን አደረጉ" (Readable); "again" is "ደግመው" (L), "እንደ ገና" (B, R). Anger: "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቁጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ" (L, B), "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእስራኤል ላይ እጅግ ተቆጣ" (R). Sold: "በ... እጅ ሸጣቸው" (L, B), "ለ... አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው" (R). Served: "የእስራኤል ልጆች ...ን N ዓመት አገለገሉ" (L), "... ለ... ለN ዓመት ተገዙ" (B), "... ለN ዓመት ለ... ለመገዛት ተገደዱ" (R). Cried: "{{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} ጮኹ" (L, B), "እንዲረዳቸው {{divine_name:ወደ እግዚአብሔር|ወደ ያህዌ}} ጮኹ" (R). Raised a deliverer: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አዳኝ አስነሣላቸው" (L, B), "... የሚያድናቸውን ሰው ሰጣቸው" (R); raised judges "መሳፍንትን አስነሣ". Rest: "ምድሪቱም N ዓመት ጸጥ አለች" (L), "ምድሪቱም ለN ዓመት ሰላም አገኘች" (B, R). The Spirit: "{{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} መንፈስ በእርሱ ላይ ሆነ" (L), "... በእርሱ ላይ መጣ" (B, R).
alternatives: varying the wording from round to round
decisions.reason: The book tells the same pattern again and again, and the Hebrew repeats its words on purpose, so each part reads the same each time it comes. The wording of "did evil" follows Deuteronomy (4:25; 31:29). "ጸጥ አለች" says what the Hebrew verb says, that the land was quiet, undisturbed by war; Balanced and Readable say it plainly, as peace.

decisions.choice: "प्रभु" in a divine_name span (setting: "याहवे") for YHWH; "प्रभु" alone for Adonai
decisions.reason: Hindi "प्रभु" stands both for the divine name YHWH (the English "the LORD") and for the title Adonai ("Lord", as Gideon says in 6:15 and Adonai YHWH, "प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}", in 6:22). Where the Hebrew has the name, "प्रभु" stands in a divine_name span and the setting shows "याहवे", the name as most scholars think it was said; where it has Adonai, "प्रभु" stands alone. So a reader can tell them apart with the setting. "यहोवा", the form of older Hindi Bibles, is not used. Postpositions stay outside the span, and God takes honorific plural agreement in both options ("प्रभु ने कहा", "वे यहूदा के साथ थे"). This holds for the whole of Judges.

decisions.choice: the sons of Israel: Literal "इस्राएल की सन्तान" in a gender span (setting: "इस्राएल के पुत्र"); Balanced and Readable "इस्राएली", with no span
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, the phrase means the whole people, women as well as men. At Literal Hindi has two wordings, the inclusive "सन्तान" (offspring) by default and the traditional "पुत्र" with the gender setting; where the agreement differs, the span takes in the verb. Balanced and Readable say "इस्राएली", the ordinary Hindi name for the people, which already includes everyone, so the English span there has nothing to change in Hindi. The same holds for the sons of Judah, of Benjamin and of Dan. This holds for the whole of Judges.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}", inflected inside each option ("ГОСПОДА|Яхве", "ГОСПОДУ|Яхве", "ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве", vocative "ГОСПОДИ|Яхве")
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as in the Pentateuch: God's personal name is written "ГОСПОДЬ" in capitals by default, like the English "the LORD", which keeps it apart from "Господь" for Adonai (6:15); the divine name setting gives "Яхве". "Иегова" is not used.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}" (L); "израильтяне" (B, R) with no setting; likewise "{{gender:дети Иуды|сыны Иуды}}", "Вениамина", "Дана" at Literal, and "воины Иуды", "люди из колена Иуды" or "колено" at Balanced and Readable
alternatives: "израильтяне" under the gender setting at Balanced and Readable, as in English
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as in the Pentateuch. The phrase means the whole people, women as well as men. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, with "дети Израиля" by default and the traditional "сыны Израиля" under the gender setting. Balanced and Readable say "израильтяне", which in Russian already includes women and men, so they need no setting where the English has one. "Иудеи" is not used for the tribe of Judah, since it now means Jews.

decisions.choice: "вопросили" (L); "спросили" (B); "спросили, как им поступить" (R)
decisions.reason: To ask of the LORD is to seek his decision (m2). Literal uses the weightier "вопросили", which says that an answer from God was sought; Balanced keeps the plain verb, and Readable adds what the asking was for, as the English adds "for guidance".

decisions.choice: "sons of Israel": "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R), with no gender span; the same for "sons of Judah", "sons of Benjamin" and the other tribes through the book
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Japanese "子ら" and "人々" already include men and women, so the English gender span is not needed (style guide section 7a).

decisions.choice: Narration in the plain style (L, B) and です・ます (R); the people speak to God politely ("〜でしょうか")
decisions.reason: As the style guide section 4 and the earlier OT books; people speaking to God use です・ます.

decisions.choice: for the whole book: "{{gender:нащадки Ізраїля|сини Ізраїля}}" (L), "ізраїльтяни" (B, R) with no span; "{{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}"; "племʼя", "рід"; the names of places and peoples as in Joshua (Гілгал, Бетель, Гезер, Негев, Шефела, ханаанеї, періззеї, амореї, гіргашеї)
decisions.reason: The terms note for the Old Testament, with the names settled in the Ukrainian Joshua so each place has one form.

decisions.choice: names of Judges settled for the book: "Отніїл", "Ехуд", "Еглон", "Шамгар", "Девора", "Варак", "Сісера", "Яїл", "Гедеон", "Єрубаал", "Авімелех", "Єфтай", "Самсон", "Маноах", "Даліла", "Міха"
decisions.reason: "Гедеон", "Варак", "Самсон" and "Єфтай" as Hebrews 11:32 and the terms note; the others transcribed from the Hebrew with г for h.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֣ה יַעֲלֶ֑ה הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh, Judah will go up; see, I have given the land into his hand.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Judah will go up. See, I have given the land into his hand."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered, "Judah is to go up. I have handed the land over to them."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered, "The tribe of Judah will go. I have already handed the land over to them."

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Yuda atapanda. Tazama, nimeitia nchi mkononi mwake."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alijibu, "Yuda ndiye atakayepanda. Nimeitia nchi hii mikononi mwao."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alijibu, "Kabila la Yuda ndilo litakalokwenda. Tayari nimeitia nchi hiyo mikononi mwao."

es.L: Y dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: «Judá subirá. Mira, he entregado la tierra en su mano.»
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió: «Judá debe subir. Ya les he entregado la tierra.»
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió: «Irá la tribu de Judá. Ya les he entregado la tierra.»

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Juda montera. Voici, j’ai donné le pays dans sa main. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondit : « C’est Juda qui doit monter. Je lui ai livré le pays. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a répondu : « C’est la tribu de Juda qui partira. Je lui ai déjà livré le pays. »

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Giu-đa sẽ đi lên. Này, Ta đã phó xứ vào tay nó."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp: "Giu-đa phải đi lên. Ta đã giao xứ ấy cho họ."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp: "Chi tộc Giu-đa sẽ đi. Ta đã giao xứ ấy cho họ rồi."

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "유다가 올라갈 것이다. 보아라, 내가 그 땅을 그의 손에 주었다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 대답하셨다. "유다가 올라가거라. 내가 그 땅을 그들에게 넘겨주었다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 대답하셨다. "유다 지파가 가거라. 내가 이미 그 땅을 그들에게 넘겨주었다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Judá subirá. Eis que entreguei a terra na sua mão."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu: "Judá é quem deve subir. Eu entreguei a terra nas mãos deles."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu: "A tribo de Judá vai primeiro. Eu já entreguei a terra a eles."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም፦ «ይሁዳ ይወጣል፤ እነሆ፣ ምድሪቱን በእጁ ሰጥቻለሁ።» አለ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም፦ «ይሁዳ ይውጣ፤ ምድሪቱን ለእነርሱ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻለሁ።» ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም፦ «የይሁዳ ነገድ ይሂድ። ምድሪቱን አስቀድሜ ለእነርሱ አሳልፌ ሰጥቻቸዋለሁ።» ብሎ መለሰ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा, "यहूदा चढ़ाई करेगा। देखो, मैंने देश को उसके हाथ में दे दिया है।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उत्तर दिया, "यहूदा चढ़ाई करे। मैंने देश उनके हाथ में सौंप दिया है।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उत्तर दिया, "यहूदा का गोत्र जाएगा। मैं यह देश उनके हाथ में सौंप चुका हूँ।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: «Иуда поднимется. Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} отдал эту землю в его руку.»
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил: «Пусть выступит Иуда. Я отдаю эту землю в его руки.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответил: «Первым пойдёт колено Иуды. Я уже отдал им эту землю.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言われた。「ユダが上る。見なさい、わたしはその地を彼の手に渡した。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は答えられた。「ユダが上って行くのだ。わたしはその地を彼らの手に渡した。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は答えられました。「ユダの部族が行く。わたしは、もうその地を彼らに渡した。」

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: «Юда піде. Ось я дав землю в його руку.»
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповів: «Нехай іде Юда. Я віддав їм цю землю.»
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} відповів: «Піде племʼя Юди. Я вже віддав їм цю землю.»

decisions.choice: I have given: a promise spoken as already done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act. Before the battle is fought God speaks of the victory as settled, as he did to Joshua at Jericho (Joshua 6:2).

decisions.choice: given into his hand: placed under his power
decisions.reason: To give something "into the hand" of someone is to put it in their control. Judah is spoken of as one person, the tribe named after Jacob's son.

decisions.choice: handed the land over to them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "them" for the tribe, where the Hebrew says "his hand"; Literal keeps the singular.

decisions.choice: God speaks in the plain style (해라체) with "나"
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for God speaking to people, in Genesis and here.

decisions.choice: "phó ... vào tay" (L); "giao ... cho" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the hand; Balanced and Readable say plainly that the land is handed over (m2). The same wording is kept wherever the LORD gives an enemy "into the hand" of Israel in these chapters.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}" mid-sentence under the setting; "Я" at the start of a sentence plainly
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as in the Pentateuch and the New Testament: every pronoun for God takes the deity_pronoun setting, "я" too when it stands inside a sentence, so that it is capitalised together with "Меня" and "Мне"; a pronoun that begins a sentence is capitalised anyway and takes no span, and the reflexive "свой", "себя" take none.

decisions.choice: Light respect forms for God in the narration ("言われた", "答えられた"); God speaks plainly ("わたしは…渡した") and the promise is in the past tense
decisions.reason: Book-wide, as the style guide section 4 and the Pentateuch; meaning decision m1: a promise spoken as already done.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוּדָה֩ לְשִׁמְע֨וֹן אָחִ֜יו עֲלֵ֧ה אִתִּ֣י בְגוֹרָלִ֗י וְנִֽלָּחֲמָה֙ בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהָלַכְתִּ֧י גַם־אֲנִ֛י אִתְּךָ֖ בְּגוֹרָלֶ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖וֹ שִׁמְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Judah to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, and let us fight against the Canaanite[s], and will go also I with you into your lot. And went with him Simeon.

en.L: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, "Come up with me into my lot, and let us fight against the Canaanites; and I also will go with you into your lot." And Simeon went with him.
en.B: Judah said to his brother Simeon, "Come up with me into the territory allotted to me, and let us fight the Canaanites together. Then I will go with you into your territory." So Simeon went with them.
en.R: The people of Judah said to the people of Simeon, their relatives, "Come with us into the land given to us, and help us fight the Canaanites. Then we will go with you into your land." So the men of Simeon went with Judah.

sw.L: Naye Yuda akamwambia Simeoni ndugu yake, "Panda pamoja nami katika kura yangu, tupigane na Wakanaani; nami pia nitakwenda pamoja nawe katika kura yako." Naye Simeoni akaenda pamoja naye.
sw.B: Yuda alimwambia Simeoni ndugu yake, "Panda pamoja nami katika eneo nililopewa kwa kura, tupigane na Wakanaani pamoja. Kisha mimi nitakwenda pamoja nawe katika eneo lako." Basi Simeoni akaenda pamoja nao.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda waliwaambia watu wa Simeoni, ndugu zao, "Njooni pamoja nasi katika nchi tuliyopewa, mtusaidie kupigana na Wakanaani. Kisha sisi tutakwenda pamoja nanyi katika nchi yenu." Basi watu wa Simeoni wakaenda pamoja na Yuda.

es.L: Y dijo Judá a Simeón su hermano: «Sube conmigo a mi suerte, y peleemos contra los cananeos; y también yo iré contigo a tu suerte.» Y Simeón fue con él.
es.B: Judá le dijo a su hermano Simeón: «Sube conmigo al territorio que me tocó en suerte, y peleemos juntos contra los cananeos. Después yo iré contigo a tu territorio.» Y Simeón fue con ellos.
es.R: La gente de Judá les dijo a sus parientes, la gente de Simeón: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} con nosotros a la tierra que nos dieron y {{plural_you:ayúdennos|ayudadnos}} a pelear contra los cananeos. Después nosotros iremos con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} a {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} tierra.» Así que los hombres de Simeón fueron con Judá.

fr.L: Et Juda dit à Siméon son frère : « Monte avec moi dans mon lot, et combattons contre les Cananéens ; et moi aussi j’irai avec toi dans ton lot. » Et Siméon alla avec lui.
fr.B: Juda dit à son frère Siméon : « Monte avec moi dans le territoire que le sort m’a donné, et combattons ensemble les Cananéens. Ensuite j’irai avec toi dans ton territoire. » Et Siméon partit avec lui.
fr.R: Les hommes de Juda ont dit à ceux de Siméon, leurs frères de sang : « Venez avec nous dans le pays qui nous a été donné, et aidez-nous à combattre les Cananéens. Ensuite nous irons avec vous dans votre pays. » Alors les hommes de Siméon sont partis avec ceux de Juda.

vi.L: Và Giu-đa nói với Si-mê-ôn, anh mình: "Hãy cùng em đi lên phần đất bắt thăm của em, và chúng ta hãy đánh người Ca-na-an; rồi em cũng sẽ đi với anh vào phần đất bắt thăm của anh." Và Si-mê-ôn đi với nó.
vi.B: Giu-đa nói với Si-mê-ôn, anh mình: "Anh hãy cùng em lên vùng đất đã bắt thăm chia cho em, và chúng ta cùng đánh người Ca-na-an. Rồi em cũng sẽ đi với anh vào vùng đất của anh." Vậy Si-mê-ôn đi với họ.
vi.R: Người Giu-đa nói với người Si-mê-ôn, là bà con của họ: "Hãy đi với chúng tôi vào vùng đất đã chia cho chúng tôi, và giúp chúng tôi đánh người Ca-na-an. Rồi chúng tôi cũng sẽ đi với anh em vào vùng đất của anh em." Vậy người Si-mê-ôn đi với người Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 그의 형제 시므온에게 말했다. "나와 함께 내 제비 [뽑은 땅]으로 올라가서 가나안 사람들과 싸우자. 그러면 나도 너와 함께 네 제비 [뽑은 땅]으로 가겠다." 그래서 시므온이 그와 함께 갔다.
ko.B: 유다가 자기 형제 시므온에게 말했다. "나와 함께 내게 제비 뽑아 나누어 준 땅으로 올라가서 같이 가나안 사람들과 싸우자. 그러면 나도 너와 함께 네 땅으로 가겠다." 그래서 시므온이 그들과 함께 갔다.
ko.R: 유다 지파 사람들이 친척인 시므온 지파 사람들에게 말했다. "우리와 함께 우리가 받은 땅으로 가서 가나안 사람들과 싸우는 것을 도와 다오. 그러면 우리도 너희와 함께 너희 땅으로 가겠다." 그래서 시므온 사람들이 유다와 함께 갔다.

pt.L: E Judá disse a Simeão, seu irmão: "Suba comigo ao meu lote, e lutemos contra os cananeus; e também eu irei com você ao seu lote." E Simeão foi com ele.
pt.B: Judá disse ao seu irmão Simeão: "Suba comigo ao território que me coube por sorteio, e vamos lutar juntos contra os cananeus. Depois eu também irei com você ao seu território." Então Simeão foi com Judá.
pt.R: O povo de Judá disse ao povo de Simeão, seus parentes: "Venham conosco à terra que recebemos e nos ajudem a lutar contra os cananeus. Depois nós iremos com vocês à terra de vocês." Então os homens de Simeão foram com Judá.

am.L: ይሁዳም ወንድሙን ስምዖንን፦ «ከነዓናውያንን እንወጋ ዘንድ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ዕጣዬ ውጣ፤ እኔም ደግሞ ከአንተ ጋር ወደ ዕጣህ እሄዳለሁ።» አለው። ስምዖንም ከእርሱ ጋር ሄደ።
am.B: ይሁዳ ወንድሙን ስምዖንን፦ «በዕጣ ወደ ተሰጠኝ ግዛት ከእኔ ጋር ውጣ፤ ከነዓናውያንንም አብረን እንውጋ። ከዚያም እኔ ደግሞ ከአንተ ጋር ወደ ግዛትህ እሄዳለሁ።» አለው። ስለዚህ ስምዖን ከእነርሱ ጋር ሄደ።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሰዎች ዘመዶቻቸው የሆኑትን የስምዖንን ሰዎች፦ «ወደ ተሰጠን ምድር ከእኛ ጋር ኑ፤ ከነዓናውያንንም ስንወጋ እርዱን። ከዚያም እኛ ደግሞ ከእናንተ ጋር ወደ ምድራችሁ እንሄዳለን።» አሏቸው። ስለዚህ የስምዖን ሰዎች ከይሁዳ ጋር ሄዱ።

hi.L: और यहूदा ने अपने भाई शिमोन से कहा, "मेरे साथ मेरे भाग में चढ़ आओ, और हम कनानियों से लड़ें; और मैं भी तुम्हारे साथ तुम्हारे भाग में चलूँगा।" और शिमोन उसके साथ गया।
hi.B: यहूदा ने अपने भाई शिमोन से कहा, "मेरे हिस्से में आए हुए देश में मेरे साथ चलो, और हम मिलकर कनानियों से लड़ें। फिर मैं भी तुम्हारे हिस्से में तुम्हारे साथ चलूँगा।" तब शिमोन उनके साथ गया।
hi.R: यहूदा के लोगों ने अपने भाई-बंधु शिमोन के लोगों से कहा, "जो देश हमें मिला है, उसमें हमारे साथ चलो और कनानियों से लड़ने में हमारी मदद करो। फिर हम भी तुम्हारे देश में तुम्हारे साथ चलेंगे।" तब शिमोन के लोग यहूदा के साथ गए।

ru.L: И сказал Иуда Симеону, своему брату: «Поднимись со мной в мой жребий, и сразимся с хананеями; и я тоже пойду с тобой в твой жребий.» И пошёл с ним Симеон.
ru.B: Иуда сказал своему брату Симеону: «Пойдём со мной в мой удел, и вместе сразимся с хананеями. А потом и я пойду с тобой в твой удел.» И Симеон пошёл с ним.
ru.R: Люди из колена Иуды сказали людям из колена Симеона, своим родственникам: «Пойдёмте с нами в землю, которая досталась нам, и помогите нам сразиться с хананеями. А потом мы пойдём с вами в вашу землю.» И воины Симеона пошли вместе с Иудой.

ja.L: そしてユダは兄弟シメオンに言った。「わたしと一緒に、わたしのくじの地に上って来てくれ。カナン人と戦おう。そうすれば、わたしもまた、あなたと一緒にあなたのくじの地に行こう。」そしてシメオンは彼と一緒に行った。
ja.B: ユダは兄弟シメオンに言った。「わたしに割り当てられた地に、一緒に上って来てほしい。共にカナン人と戦おう。その後で、わたしもあなたの地に一緒に行こう。」こうしてシメオンはユダと共に行った。
ja.R: ユダの部族の人々は、親類であるシメオンの部族の人々に言いました。「わたしたちに与えられた土地へ一緒に来て、カナン人と戦うのを手伝ってほしい。そうしたら、わたしたちも、あなたたちの土地へ一緒に行こう。」それでシメオンの人々は、ユダと一緒に行きました。

uk.L: І сказав Юда Симеонові, своєму братові: «Іди зі мною в мій жереб, і воюймо з ханаанеями; і я також піду з тобою в твій жереб.» І пішов з ним Симеон.
uk.B: Юда сказав своєму братові Симеонові: «Іди зі мною на землю, що випала мені жеребом, і воюймо разом з ханаанеями. Потім я піду з тобою на твою землю.» Тож Симеон пішов з ними.
uk.R: Люди Юди сказали людям Симеона, своїм родичам: «Ходіть з нами на землю, дану нам, і допоможіть нам воювати з ханаанеями. Потім ми підемо з вами на вашу землю.» Тож чоловіки Симеона пішли з Юдою.

decisions.choice: Judah and Simeon: brother tribes whose lands were joined
decisions.reason: Judah and Simeon were both sons of Jacob and Leah (Genesis 29:33-35), and the tribe of Simeon received its towns inside the land of Judah (Joshua 19:1, 9). The tribes speak as the brothers they are named after.

decisions.choice: lot: the territory given by lot
decisions.reason: The land was shared out by casting lots before the LORD (Joshua 14:2; 18:10), so a tribe's "lot" is the land it received that way.

decisions.choice: territory allotted to me (B); the land given to us; the people of Judah, of Simeon (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "lot" means once and then says "territory". Readable speaks of the tribes as peoples rather than as two brothers, so that a young reader does not picture two men. Balanced and Readable say "them" and "Judah" where the Hebrew says "him".

decisions.choice: "kura" (L) and "eneo nililopewa kwa kura" (B) for the allotted territory
decisions.reason: Swahili "kura" is the lot that was cast, and by extension the share it gave, as the terms note sets for these books. Literal keeps the bare word; Balanced says that the land was given by lot, as the English Balanced says "territory allotted to me".

decisions.choice: "suerte" (L); "el territorio que me tocó en suerte" (B); "la tierra que nos dieron" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the lot by which land was shared out, and so the land itself (m2). The terms note for these books uses "suerte" for the lot; Literal keeps it as the land's name, Balanced says the land that fell by lot, and Readable says only the land given.

decisions.choice: "lot" (L); "le territoire que le sort m'a donné" (B); "le pays qui nous a été donné" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the piece of land each tribe received by lot (Joshua 14-19). French "lot" keeps the word at Literal; Balanced says how the land was given, and Readable, which speaks of the tribes as groups of people, simply says the land given to them, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Judah calls Simeon "anh" and himself "em"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say which brother is older. Simeon was Jacob's second son and Judah his fourth (Genesis 29:33-35), so the tribe of Judah speaks as the younger brother; Readable, which speaks of the two peoples (m1), uses "chúng tôi" and "anh em".

decisions.choice: "phần đất bắt thăm" (L); "vùng đất đã bắt thăm chia cho" (B); "vùng đất đã chia cho" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the lot by which the land was shared out (m2); "thăm" is the word for the lot in these books.

decisions.choice: Judah and Simeon speak to each other in the plain style between equals (해라체), as brothers
decisions.reason: The two tribes are spoken of as brothers; Korean uses the plain style between equals. "제비" (lot) is kept at Literal, with the land it gave in brackets.

decisions.choice: o meu lote (L); o território que me coube por sorteio (B); a terra que recebemos (R); você (L, B), vocês (R)
decisions.reason: "Lote" is both a share drawn by lot and a plot of land in Brazilian Portuguese, so Literal keeps the Hebrew picture (m2) in one ordinary word; "sorte" would read as luck. Balanced says once how the land was shared, as Joshua 14:2 has it in Portuguese ("por sorteio"). The brothers speak to each other with "você"; Readable, which speaks of two peoples, says "vocês".

decisions.choice: "भाग" (L); "हिस्से में आया हुआ देश", then "हिस्सा" (B)
decisions.reason: The lot here is the land given by lot (m2). Literal says "भाग" (portion), Balanced says once what the portion is and then "हिस्सा", as the English Balanced says "territory".

decisions.choice: "жребий" (L); "удел" (B); "земля, которая досталась нам" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "lot" for the land given by lot (m2). Literal keeps the word; Balanced says "удел", the land allotted; Readable says plainly whose land it is and speaks of the tribes as peoples, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "lot" (goral): "くじの地" (L), "割り当てられた地" (B)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2: the territory given by lot; Literal keeps the lot, Balanced says what it is.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֖י בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיַּכּ֣וּם בְּבֶ֔זֶק עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up Judah, and gave Yahweh the Canaanite[s] and the Perizzite[s] into their hand, and they struck them at Bezek, ten thousand man.

en.L: And Judah went up, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand, and they struck them at Bezek, 10,000 men.
en.B: When Judah went up, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} handed the Canaanites and the Perizzites over to them, and they defeated 10,000 men at Bezek.
en.R: So Judah attacked, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} let them defeat the Canaanites and the Perizzites. At the town of Bezek they defeated 10,000 of their men.

sw.L: Naye Yuda akapanda, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawatia Wakanaani na Waperizi mkononi mwao, nao wakawapiga huko Bezeki, watu elfu kumi.
sw.B: Yuda alipopanda, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwatia Wakanaani na Waperizi mikononi mwao, nao wakawashinda watu elfu kumi huko Bezeki.
sw.R: Basi watu wa Yuda walishambulia, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawawezesha kuwashinda Wakanaani na Waperizi. Katika mji wa Bezeki waliwashinda watu wao elfu kumi.

es.L: Y subió Judá, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} entregó a los cananeos y a los ferezeos en su mano, y los hirieron en Bezec, 10 000 hombres.
es.B: Cuando Judá subió, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les entregó a los cananeos y a los ferezeos, y derrotaron a 10 000 hombres en Bezec.
es.R: Entonces Judá atacó, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les dio la victoria sobre los cananeos y los ferezeos. En la ciudad de Bezec derrotaron a 10 000 de sus hombres.

fr.L: Et Juda monta, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} livra les Cananéens et les Phéréziens dans leur main, et ils les frappèrent à Bézeq, dix mille hommes.
fr.B: Juda monta, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui livra les Cananéens et les Phéréziens ; ils battirent dix mille hommes à Bézeq.
fr.R: La tribu de Juda a donc attaqué, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a donné la victoire sur les Cananéens et les Phéréziens. Près de la ville de Bézeq, ses hommes ont battu dix mille de leurs soldats.

vi.L: Và Giu-đa đi lên, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phó người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít vào tay họ; và họ đánh giết chúng tại Bê-xéc, mười nghìn người.
vi.B: Khi Giu-đa đi lên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giao người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít cho họ, và họ đánh bại mười nghìn người tại Bê-xéc.
vi.R: Vậy quân Giu-đa tấn công, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho họ thắng người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít. Tại thành Bê-xéc, họ đánh bại mười nghìn người của quân địch.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 올라갔고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 그들의 손에 주셨다. 그들이 베섹에서 그들을 쳤는데, 만 명이었다.
ko.B: 유다가 올라가자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 그들에게 넘겨주셨다. 그들은 베섹에서 만 명을 쳐부수었다.
ko.R: 그래서 유다 사람들이 공격했고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그들이 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 이기게 하셨다. 그들은 베섹 성읍에서 적군 만 명을 무찔렀다.

pt.L: E Judá subiu, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} entregou os cananeus e os ferezeus na mão deles, e os feriram em Bezeque: dez mil homens.
pt.B: Quando Judá subiu, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} entregou nas mãos deles os cananeus e os ferezeus, e eles derrotaram dez mil homens em Bezeque.
pt.R: Então Judá atacou, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez com que eles vencessem os cananeus e os ferezeus. Na cidade de Bezeque, derrotaram dez mil homens deles.

am.L: ይሁዳም ወጣ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንን በእጃቸው ሰጠ፤ በቤዜቅም 10,000 ሰዎችን መቱ።
am.B: ይሁዳ በወጣ ጊዜ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንን አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ በቤዜቅም 10,000 ሰዎችን ድል አደረጉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ይሁዳ ዘመተ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንን ድል እንዲያደርጉ ፈቀደላቸው። በቤዜቅ ከተማ ከሰዎቻቸው 10,000 ያህሉን ድል አደረጉ።

hi.L: और यहूदा ने चढ़ाई की, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कनानियों और परिज्जियों को उनके हाथ में कर दिया, और उन्होंने बेजेक में उन्हें मारा, दस हज़ार पुरुष।
hi.B: जब यहूदा ने चढ़ाई की, तो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कनानियों और परिज्जियों को उनके हाथ में सौंप दिया, और उन्होंने बेजेक में दस हज़ार पुरुषों को हरा दिया।
hi.R: तब यहूदा ने हमला किया, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उन्हें कनानियों और परिज्जियों पर जीत दी। बेजेक नाम के नगर में उन्होंने उनके दस हज़ार आदमियों को हरा दिया।

ru.L: И поднялся Иуда, и отдал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} хананеев и ферезеев в их руку, и поразили они их в Везеке — десять тысяч человек.
ru.B: Когда Иуда выступил, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} отдал хананеев и ферезеев в их руки, и они разбили у Везека десять тысяч человек.
ru.R: Колено Иуды пошло в бой, и {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} дал им победу над хананеями и ферезеями. У города Везека они разбили десять тысяч их воинов.

ja.L: そしてユダは上った。そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はカナン人とペリジ人を彼らの手に渡された。彼らはベゼクで彼らを打った。一万人であった。
ja.B: ユダが攻め上ると、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はカナン人とペリジ人を彼らの手に渡された。彼らはベゼクで一万人を打ち破った。
ja.R: そこでユダは攻めに行きました。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ユダがカナン人とペリジ人に勝つようにしてくださいました。ベゼクという町で、ユダは敵の兵を一万人打ち負かしました。

uk.L: І пішов Юда, і дав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} ханаанеїв і періззеїв у їхню руку, і вони побили їх у Безеку, десять тисяч чоловік.
uk.B: Коли Юда пішов, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} віддав їм ханаанеїв і періззеїв, і вони розбили в Безеку десять тисяч чоловік.
uk.R: Тож Юда пішов у наступ, і {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} дав їм перемогти ханаанеїв і періззеїв. Біля міста Безек вони розбили десять тисяч їхніх воїнів.

decisions.choice: the Perizzites; Bezek: a people of the land and a town whose site is uncertain
decisions.reason: The Perizzites are named beside the Canaanites as people of the land from Abraham's time (Genesis 13:7; 34:30). Bezek is not known for certain. A Bezek in 1 Samuel 11:8 lay farther north, near the Jordan, and may or may not be the same place.

decisions.choice: ten thousand: the word for "thousand" may also name a unit of fighting men
decisions.reason: As noted at Numbers 1, the word for "thousand" can also be used of a military or clan unit, which would give a smaller number of men.

decisions.choice: the LORD gave them into their hand: the LORD gave Judah the victory
decisions.reason: The words fulfil the promise of verse 2. The battle is told as the LORD's gift before it is told as Judah's deed.

decisions.choice: the town of
decisions.reason: Readable adds "the town of" before Bezek so the reader knows it is a place.

decisions.choice: the peoples and places of this chapter in their usual Spanish forms: "los ferezeos", "Bezec", "Adoni-bezec", "Quiriat-arbá", "Sesai", "Ahimán", "Talmai", "Debir", "Quiriat-séfer", "Acsa", "Otoniel hijo de Quenaz", "el Néguev", "la Sefelá", "Horma", "Ascalón", "Ecrón", "los jebuseos", "Betel", "Luz", "Bet-seán", "Taanac", "Meguido", "Quitrón", "Naalal", "Aco", "Aczib", "Afec", "Bet-semes", "Bet-anat", "Ajalón", "Saalbim", "Acrabim"
alternatives: closer transcriptions of the Hebrew ("Perizitas", "Qiryat Arba")
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges: names follow the forms long used in Spanish Bibles, with Spanish accents, and the forms already used in the Pentateuch ("los ferezeos", "Quiriat-arbá", "Horma", "el Néguev", "la Sefelá"). Readable adds "la ciudad de" only where the English Readable says "the town of".

decisions.choice: "les Phéréziens", "Bézeq", and the other names of the chapter in their French form ("Adoni-Bézeq", "Kiryath-Arba", "Kiryath-Sépher", "Aksa", "Otniel", "Horma", "Beth-Shéan", "Meguiddo", "Guézer")
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10: names follow the forms already used in the French Pentateuch where there is one ("les Phéréziens", "les Jébusiens", "les Kéniens", "Horma", "Anaq") and the terms note for Joshua, Judges and Ruth ("Otniel", "Éhoud", "Débora", "Yaël", "Gédéon", "Abimélek"); other names transcribe the Hebrew with French accents, writing "q" for qof (Bézeq) and "sh" for shin (Beth-Shéan).

decisions.choice: os ferezeus; Bezeque; dez mil
decisions.reason: "Os ferezeus" is the form Genesis 13:7 and Joshua use in Portuguese. "Bezeque" takes the Brazilian ending for the Hebrew final k, as "Melquisedeque" and "Adoni-Zedeque" do. A round number is written in words in running text (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 5).

decisions.choice: "Безек", "Адоні-Безек", "Цефат", "Кітрон", "Нахалол", "Акко", "Ахлав", "Хелба", "Афік", "гора Херес", "Шаалбім", "Села"
decisions.reason: Transcribed from the Hebrew; "Акко" rather than the Greek name the town bears in Acts 21:7.

source.text: וַֽ֠יִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִ֥י בֶ֨זֶק֙ בְּבֶ֔זֶק וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ בּ֑וֹ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And they found Adoni-Bezek at Bezek, and they fought against him, and they struck the Canaanite[s] and the Perizzite[s].

en.L: And they found Adoni-Bezek at Bezek, and they fought against him, and they struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
en.B: They came upon Adoni-Bezek at Bezek and fought against him, and they defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
en.R: At Bezek they met the ruler, Adoni-Bezek. They fought against him and defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

sw.L: Nao wakamkuta Adoni-Bezeki huko Bezeki, wakapigana naye, wakawapiga Wakanaani na Waperizi.
sw.B: Walimkuta Adoni-Bezeki huko Bezeki, wakapigana naye, wakawashinda Wakanaani na Waperizi.
sw.R: Huko Bezeki walikutana na mtawala wa mji, Adoni-Bezeki. Walipigana naye, wakawashinda Wakanaani na Waperizi.

es.L: Y hallaron a Adoni-bezec en Bezec, y pelearon contra él, e hirieron a los cananeos y a los ferezeos.
es.B: En Bezec se encontraron con Adoni-bezec y pelearon contra él, y derrotaron a los cananeos y a los ferezeos.
es.R: En Bezec se encontraron con el gobernante, Adoni-bezec. Pelearon contra él y derrotaron a los cananeos y a los ferezeos.

fr.L: Et ils trouvèrent Adoni-Bézeq à Bézeq, et ils combattirent contre lui, et ils frappèrent les Cananéens et les Phéréziens.
fr.B: Ils rencontrèrent Adoni-Bézeq à Bézeq et lui livrèrent bataille, et ils battirent les Cananéens et les Phéréziens.
fr.R: À Bézeq, ils ont rencontré le roi de la ville, Adoni-Bézeq. Ils l’ont attaqué et ont battu les Cananéens et les Phéréziens.

vi.L: Và họ gặp A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc tại Bê-xéc, và họ giao chiến với ông, và họ đánh giết người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít.
vi.B: Họ gặp A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc tại Bê-xéc và giao chiến với ông, rồi đánh bại người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít.
vi.R: Tại Bê-xéc, họ gặp vua của thành ấy là A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc. Họ giao chiến với ông và đánh bại người Ca-na-an và người Phê-rê-sít.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 베섹에서 아도니베섹을 만나 그와 싸웠고, 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 쳤다.
ko.B: 그들은 베섹에서 아도니베섹과 마주쳐 그와 싸웠고, 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 쳐부수었다.
ko.R: 베섹에서 그들은 그곳의 통치자 아도니베섹을 만났다. 그들은 그와 싸워 가나안 사람들과 브리스 사람들을 무찔렀다.

pt.L: E acharam Adoni-Bezeque em Bezeque, e lutaram contra ele, e feriram os cananeus e os ferezeus.
pt.B: Encontraram Adoni-Bezeque em Bezeque, lutaram contra ele e derrotaram os cananeus e os ferezeus.
pt.R: Em Bezeque, eles enfrentaram o governante da cidade, Adoni-Bezeque. Lutaram contra ele e derrotaram os cananeus e os ferezeus.

am.L: አዶኒቤዜቅንም በቤዜቅ አገኙት፤ ወጉትም፤ ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንንም መቱ።
am.B: በቤዜቅም አዶኒቤዜቅን አግኝተው ወጉት፤ ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንንም ድል አደረጉ።
am.R: በቤዜቅ ገዢውን አዶኒቤዜቅን ገጠሙት። ወግተውትም ከነዓናውያንንና ፌርዛውያንን ድል አደረጉ።

hi.L: और बेजेक में उन्होंने अदोनी-बेजेक को पाया, और उससे लड़े, और कनानियों और परिज्जियों को मारा।
hi.B: बेजेक में उनका सामना अदोनी-बेजेक से हुआ। वे उससे लड़े और उन्होंने कनानियों और परिज्जियों को हरा दिया।
hi.R: बेजेक में उनका सामना वहाँ के राजा अदोनी-बेजेक से हुआ। वे उससे लड़े और कनानियों और परिज्जियों को हरा दिया।

ru.L: И нашли они Адони-Везека в Везеке, и сразились с ним, и поразили хананеев и ферезеев.
ru.B: В Везеке они встретили Адони-Везека, сразились с ним и разбили хананеев и ферезеев.
ru.R: В Везеке они встретились с правителем этого города, Адони-Везеком. Они сразились с ним и разбили хананеев и ферезеев.

ja.L: そして彼らはベゼクでアドニ・ベゼクを見つけ、彼と戦い、カナン人とペリジ人を打った。
ja.B: 彼らはベゼクでアドニ・ベゼクに出会って戦い、カナン人とペリジ人を打ち破った。
ja.R: ベゼクで、彼らはその町の支配者アドニ・ベゼクに出会いました。彼らはアドニ・ベゼクと戦って、カナン人とペリジ人を打ち負かしました。

uk.L: І знайшли Адоні-Безека в Безеку, і воювали проти нього, і побили ханаанеїв і періззеїв.
uk.B: У Безеку вони натрапили на Адоні-Безека і воювали проти нього, і розбили ханаанеїв і періззеїв.
uk.R: Біля Безека вони зустріли правителя, Адоні-Безека. Вони воювали проти нього і розбили ханаанеїв і періззеїв.

decisions.choice: Adoni-Bezek: "lord of Bezek", the ruler of the town
decisions.reason: The name means "lord of Bezek" and may be a title rather than a personal name. It is formed like the name of Adoni-Zedek, king of Jerusalem (Joshua 10:1). Verse 7 shows him as a king who had ruled over other kings.

decisions.choice: they found: they met him in battle
decisions.reason: "Found" here means came upon or met with an enemy, as in 1 Samuel 31:3. The verse goes back over the battle of verse 4 to bring in its king.

decisions.choice: the ruler
decisions.reason: Readable says who Adoni-Bezek was, as his name and verse 7 show.

decisions.choice: the names in this chapter: "A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc", "Hếp-rôn", "Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba", "Đê-bia", "Ki-ri-át Sê-phe", "Ạc-sa", "Ốt-ni-ên", "Họt-ma", "Bết-Sê-an", "Mê-ghi-đô"
decisions.reason: Names follow the Protestant transliterations, as the terms note for Joshua, Judges and Ruth sets; the towns of the lists in verses 27-35 keep every name.

decisions.choice: Adoni-Bezeque
decisions.reason: The hyphen keeps the two parts of the name, "lord of Bezek" (m1), visible, as "Adoni-Zedeque" does in Joshua 10:1 in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: Adoni-Bezek "アドニ・ベゼク", written with a middle dot as a compound name; Bezek "ベゼク"
decisions.reason: Two-part Hebrew names are written with a middle dot, as ベエル・シェバ and ベト・ペオル in the earlier books.

source.text: וַיָּ֨נָס֙ אֲדֹ֣נִי בֶ֔זֶק וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֖וּ אַחֲרָ֑יו וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וַֽיְקַצְּצ֔וּ אֶת־בְּהֹנ֥וֹת יָדָ֖יו וְרַגְלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And fled Adoni-Bezek, and they pursued after him, and they seized him, and they cut off [the] thumbs of his hands and his feet.

en.L: And Adoni-Bezek fled, and they pursued after him and seized him, and they cut off the thumbs of his hands and of his feet.
en.B: Adoni-Bezek ran away, but they chased him and caught him, and they cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
en.R: Adoni-Bezek ran away, but they chased him and caught him. Then they cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

sw.L: Naye Adoni-Bezeki akakimbia, nao wakamfuatia, wakamkamata, wakamkata vidole gumba vya mikono yake na vya miguu yake.
sw.B: Adoni-Bezeki alikimbia, lakini walimfuatia, wakamkamata, wakamkata vidole gumba vya mikono na vidole vikubwa vya miguu.
sw.R: Adoni-Bezeki alikimbia, lakini walimfuatia na kumkamata. Kisha wakamkata vidole gumba vya mikono yake na vidole vikubwa vya miguu yake.

es.L: Y huyó Adoni-bezec, y lo persiguieron y lo prendieron, y le cortaron los pulgares de sus manos y de sus pies.
es.B: Adoni-bezec huyó, pero lo persiguieron y lo atraparon, y le cortaron los pulgares de las manos y los dedos gordos de los pies.
es.R: Adoni-bezec huyó, pero lo persiguieron y lo atraparon. Entonces le cortaron los pulgares de las manos y los dedos gordos de los pies.

fr.L: Et Adoni-Bézeq s’enfuit, et ils le poursuivirent et le saisirent, et ils lui coupèrent les pouces des mains et des pieds.
fr.B: Adoni-Bézeq s’enfuit, mais ils le poursuivirent et le capturèrent, puis ils lui coupèrent les pouces et les gros orteils.
fr.R: Adoni-Bézeq s’est enfui, mais ils l’ont poursuivi et l’ont attrapé. Puis ils lui ont coupé les pouces et les gros orteils.

vi.L: Và A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc chạy trốn, và họ đuổi theo ông và bắt được ông, và họ chặt các ngón cái của tay ông và của chân ông.
vi.B: A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc bỏ chạy, nhưng họ đuổi theo bắt được ông, rồi chặt các ngón tay cái và ngón chân cái của ông.
vi.R: A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc bỏ chạy, nhưng họ đuổi theo và bắt được ông. Rồi họ chặt ngón tay cái và ngón chân cái của ông.

ko.L: 그리고 아도니베섹이 도망하였으나, 그들이 그의 뒤를 쫓아가 그를 붙잡았다. 그리고 그들이 그의 손과 발의 엄지가락을 잘랐다.
ko.B: 아도니베섹이 달아났으나, 그들은 그를 뒤쫓아 붙잡았다. 그리고 그의 엄지손가락과 엄지발가락을 잘랐다.
ko.R: 아도니베섹은 달아났지만, 그들은 그를 쫓아가 붙잡았다. 그리고 그의 엄지손가락과 엄지발가락을 잘라 버렸다.

pt.L: E Adoni-Bezeque fugiu, e o perseguiram, e o agarraram, e cortaram os polegares das suas mãos e dos seus pés.
pt.B: Adoni-Bezeque fugiu, mas eles o perseguiram e o pegaram, e cortaram os seus polegares e os dedões dos seus pés.
pt.R: Adoni-Bezeque fugiu, mas eles correram atrás dele e o pegaram. Depois cortaram os polegares das mãos dele e os dedões dos pés.

am.L: አዶኒቤዜቅም ሸሸ፤ ተከትለውም አሳደዱት፤ ያዙትም፤ የእጆቹንና የእግሮቹንም አውራ ጣቶች ቆረጡ።
am.B: አዶኒቤዜቅ ሸሸ፤ እነርሱ ግን አሳደው ያዙት፤ የእጆቹንና የእግሮቹንም አውራ ጣቶች ቆረጡ።
am.R: አዶኒቤዜቅ ሸሸ፤ እነርሱ ግን አሳደው ያዙት። ከዚያም የእጆቹንና የእግሮቹን አውራ ጣቶች ቆረጡ።

hi.L: और अदोनी-बेजेक भागा, और उन्होंने उसका पीछा किया और उसे पकड़ लिया, और उसके हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे काट डाले।
hi.B: अदोनी-बेजेक भाग निकला, पर उन्होंने उसका पीछा करके उसे पकड़ लिया और उसके हाथों के अँगूठे और पैरों के अँगूठे काट डाले।
hi.R: अदोनी-बेजेक भाग गया, पर उन्होंने उसका पीछा किया और उसे पकड़ लिया। फिर उन्होंने उसके हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे काट दिए।

ru.L: И бежал Адони-Везек, и погнались они за ним, и схватили его, и отрубили большие пальцы его рук и его ног.
ru.B: Адони-Везек бежал, но они погнались за ним, схватили его и отрубили ему большие пальцы на руках и на ногах.
ru.R: Адони-Везек убежал, но они погнались за ним и поймали его. Потом они отрубили ему большие пальцы на руках и на ногах.

ja.L: そしてアドニ・ベゼクは逃げた。彼らは彼の後を追い、彼を捕らえ、彼の手と足の親指を切り落とした。
ja.B: アドニ・ベゼクは逃げたが、彼らは追いかけて捕らえ、その手の親指と足の親指を切り落とした。
ja.R: アドニ・ベゼクは逃げましたが、彼らは追いかけて捕まえました。そして、両手の親指と両足の親指を切り落としました。

uk.L: І втік Адоні-Безек, і гналися за ним, і схопили його, і відрубали великі пальці його рук і його ніг.
uk.B: Адоні-Безек утік, але вони погналися за ним і схопили його, і відрубали йому великі пальці на руках і на ногах.
uk.R: Адоні-Безек утік, але вони погналися за ним і схопили його. Потім відрубали йому великі пальці на руках і на ногах.

decisions.choice: thumbs of his hands and his feet: his thumbs and his big toes
decisions.reason: One word serves for both the thumb and the big toe. It is the same word used when blood was put on the right thumb and the right big toe of the priests at their ordination (Exodus 29:20; Leviticus 8:23).

decisions.choice: cutting off thumbs and big toes: a maiming that ended a man's power to fight or rule
decisions.reason: Without thumbs a man cannot grip a sword or a bow, and without big toes he cannot stand firm or run in battle. It also shamed him. Verse 7 shows that Adoni-Bezek had done the same to others.

decisions.choice: his thumbs and his big toes
decisions.reason: English has two words where the Hebrew has one; Literal keeps the Hebrew form "thumbs of his hands and of his feet".

decisions.choice: os polegares e os dedões dos pés
decisions.reason: "Dedão do pé" is the everyday Brazilian word for the big toe and the one Exodus 29:20 uses in Portuguese for the same Hebrew word (m1); Literal keeps the one word for both, "os polegares das suas mãos e dos seus pés", as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: "አውራ ጣቶች" of both hands and feet, at every level.
alternatives: "thumbs" and "big toes" as two different words
decisions.reason: Amharic calls both the thumb and the big toe "አውራ ጣት", so "the thumbs of his hands and his feet" can be said as the Hebrew says it, at every level.

decisions.choice: "हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे"
decisions.reason: Hindi "अँगूठा" names both the thumb and the big toe, as the Hebrew word does, so Hindi can keep the Hebrew's one word at every level where English needs two.

decisions.choice: "большие пальцы" of the hands and feet at every level
decisions.reason: Russian has one phrase, "большой палец", for both the thumb and the big toe, as the Hebrew has one word, so every level can keep the Hebrew's shape; the English needs two words at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹֽנִי־בֶ֗זֶק שִׁבְעִ֣ים׀מְלָכִ֡ים בְּֽהֹנוֹת֩ יְדֵיהֶ֨ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֜ם מְקֻצָּצִ֗ים הָי֤וּ מְלַקְּטִים֙ תַּ֣חַת שֻׁלְחָנִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי כֵּ֥ן שִׁלַּם־לִ֖י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיְבִיאֻ֥הוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said Adoni-Bezek, Seventy kings, [the] thumbs of their hands and their feet cut off, were gathering under my table; as I have done, so has repaid to me God. And they brought him [to] Jerusalem, and he died there.

en.L: And Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings, with the thumbs of their hands and their feet cut off, used to gather [scraps] under my table. As I have done, so God has repaid me." And they brought him [to] Jerusalem, and he died there.
en.B: Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings, their thumbs and big toes cut off, used to pick up scraps under my table. God has paid me back for what I did." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
en.R: Adoni-Bezek said, "I once had seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off. They had to pick up scraps of food under my table. Now God has done to me what I did to them." They took him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

sw.L: Naye Adoni-Bezeki akasema, "Wafalme sabini, waliokatwa vidole gumba vya mikono yao na vya miguu yao, walikuwa wakiokota [makombo] chini ya meza yangu. Kama nilivyotenda, ndivyo Mungu alivyonilipa." Nao wakamleta [mpaka] Yerusalemu, naye akafa huko.
sw.B: Adoni-Bezeki alisema, "Wafalme sabini, waliokatwa vidole gumba na vidole vikubwa vya miguu, walikuwa wakiokota makombo chini ya meza yangu. Mungu amenilipa kwa yale niliyotenda." Walimleta Yerusalemu, naye akafa huko.
sw.R: Adoni-Bezeki alisema, "Zamani nilikuwa na wafalme sabini niliowakata vidole gumba na vidole vikubwa vya miguu. Walilazimika kuokota makombo ya chakula chini ya meza yangu. Sasa Mungu amenitendea yale niliyowatendea wao." Walimpeleka Yerusalemu, naye akafa huko.

es.L: Y dijo Adoni-bezec: «Setenta reyes, con los pulgares de sus manos y de sus pies cortados, recogían [migajas] debajo de mi mesa. Como yo hice, así me ha pagado Dios.» Y lo llevaron [a] Jerusalén, y murió allí.
es.B: Adoni-bezec dijo: «Setenta reyes, con los pulgares de las manos y de los pies cortados, recogían migajas debajo de mi mesa. Dios me ha pagado conforme a lo que hice.» Lo llevaron a Jerusalén, y allí murió.
es.R: Adoni-bezec dijo: «Yo tuve setenta reyes con los pulgares de las manos y de los pies cortados. Tenían que recoger las migajas de comida debajo de mi mesa. Ahora Dios me ha hecho lo mismo que yo les hice a ellos.» Lo llevaron a Jerusalén, y allí murió.

fr.L: Et Adoni-Bézeq dit : « Soixante-dix rois, les pouces de leurs mains et de leurs pieds coupés, ramassaient [des restes] sous ma table. Comme j’ai fait, ainsi Dieu m’a rendu. » Et ils l’amenèrent [à] Jérusalem, et il mourut là.
fr.B: Adoni-Bézeq dit : « Soixante-dix rois, aux pouces et aux gros orteils coupés, ramassaient les restes sous ma table. Dieu m’a rendu ce que j’ai fait. » On l’emmena à Jérusalem, et il y mourut.
fr.R: Adoni-Bézeq a dit : « Autrefois, j’avais soixante-dix rois à qui on avait coupé les pouces et les gros orteils. Ils devaient ramasser les restes de nourriture sous ma table. Maintenant, Dieu m’a fait ce que je leur ai fait. » Ils l’ont emmené à Jérusalem, et il est mort là-bas.

vi.L: Và A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc nói: "Bảy mươi vua, các ngón cái của tay họ và của chân họ bị chặt, đã từng nhặt [vụn bánh] dưới bàn của ta. Ta đã làm thế nào, Đức Chúa Trời đã báo trả ta thế ấy." Và họ đem ông đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, và ông chết tại đó.
vi.B: A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc nói: "Bảy mươi vua bị chặt ngón tay cái và ngón chân cái đã từng phải nhặt vụn bánh dưới bàn ta. Đức Chúa Trời đã báo trả ta đúng như việc ta đã làm." Họ đem ông về Giê-ru-sa-lem, và ông chết tại đó.
vi.R: A-đô-ni-Bê-xéc nói: "Trước kia ta đã có bảy mươi vua bị chặt ngón tay cái và ngón chân cái. Họ phải nhặt từng mẩu thức ăn rơi dưới bàn ta. Bây giờ Đức Chúa Trời đã làm cho ta đúng như điều ta đã làm cho họ." Người ta đem ông về Giê-ru-sa-lem, và ông chết tại đó.

ko.L: 그러자 아도니베섹이 말했다. "손과 발의 엄지가락이 잘린 일흔 명의 왕이 내 식탁 아래에서 [부스러기를] 주워 모으곤 하였다. 내가 행한 그대로 하나님께서 나에게 갚으셨다." 그리고 그들이 그를 예루살렘으로 데려갔고, 그는 거기서 죽었다.
ko.B: 아도니베섹이 말했다. "엄지손가락과 엄지발가락이 잘린 왕 일흔 명이 내 식탁 밑에서 부스러기를 주워 먹곤 했다. 내가 한 대로 하나님께서 나에게 갚으셨구나." 그들은 그를 예루살렘으로 데려갔고, 그는 거기서 죽었다.
ko.R: 아도니베섹이 말했다. "전에 나는 엄지손가락과 엄지발가락이 잘린 왕 일흔 명을 데리고 있었다. 그들은 내 식탁 밑에서 음식 부스러기를 주워 먹어야 했다. 이제 하나님께서 내가 그들에게 한 그대로 나에게 하셨구나." 사람들이 그를 예루살렘으로 데려갔고, 그는 거기서 죽었다.

pt.L: E Adoni-Bezeque disse: "Setenta reis, com os polegares das suas mãos e dos seus pés cortados, apanhavam [migalhas] debaixo da minha mesa. Como eu fiz, assim Deus me retribuiu." E o levaram [para] Jerusalém, e ele morreu ali.
pt.B: Adoni-Bezeque disse: "Setenta reis, com os polegares e os dedões dos pés cortados, catavam migalhas debaixo da minha mesa. Deus me pagou pelo que eu fiz." Eles o levaram para Jerusalém, e ali ele morreu.
pt.R: Adoni-Bezeque disse: "Eu tinha setenta reis com os polegares e os dedões dos pés cortados. Eles tinham de catar restos de comida debaixo da minha mesa. Agora Deus fez comigo o que eu fiz com eles." Eles o levaram para Jerusalém, e ele morreu lá.

am.L: አዶኒቤዜቅም፦ «የእጆቻቸውና የእግሮቻቸው አውራ ጣቶች የተቆረጡ ሰባ ነገሥታት ከማዕዴ በታች [ፍርፋሪ] ይለቅሙ ነበር፤ እኔ እንዳደረግኩ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር ከፈለኝ።» አለ። [ወደ] ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጡት፤ በዚያም ሞተ።
am.B: አዶኒቤዜቅም፦ «የእጅና የእግር አውራ ጣቶቻቸው የተቆረጡ ሰባ ነገሥታት ከማዕዴ በታች ፍርፋሪ ይለቅሙ ነበር። እግዚአብሔር ስላደረግኩት ነገር ብድራቴን ከፈለኝ።» አለ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጡት፤ በዚያም ሞተ።
am.R: አዶኒቤዜቅም፦ «በአንድ ወቅት የእጅና የእግር አውራ ጣቶቻቸው የተቆረጡ ሰባ ነገሥታት ነበሩኝ። ከማዕዴ በታች የምግብ ፍርፋሪ ይለቅሙ ነበር። እኔ በእነርሱ ላይ ያደረግኩትን አሁን እግዚአብሔር በእኔ ላይ አደረገ።» አለ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወሰዱት፤ በዚያም ሞተ።

hi.L: और अदोनी-बेजेक ने कहा, "सत्तर राजा, जिनके हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे काटे गए थे, मेरी मेज़ के नीचे [टुकड़े] बीना करते थे। जैसा मैंने किया था, वैसा ही परमेश्वर ने मुझे बदला दिया है।" और वे उसे यरूशलेम ले आए, और वह वहाँ मर गया।
hi.B: अदोनी-बेजेक ने कहा, "सत्तर राजा, जिनके हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे कटे हुए थे, मेरी मेज़ के नीचे जूठन बीनते थे। जो मैंने किया, उसका बदला परमेश्वर ने मुझे दे दिया है।" वे उसे यरूशलेम ले आए, और वहीं वह मर गया।
hi.R: अदोनी-बेजेक ने कहा, "मेरे पास कभी सत्तर राजा थे जिनके हाथों और पैरों के अँगूठे कटे हुए थे। वे मेरी मेज़ के नीचे गिरे हुए खाने के टुकड़े बीनते थे। अब परमेश्वर ने मेरे साथ वही किया है जो मैंने उनके साथ किया था।" वे उसे यरूशलेम ले गए, और वहाँ वह मर गया।

ru.L: И сказал Адони-Везек: «Семьдесят царей с отрубленными большими пальцами их рук и их ног подбирали [крохи] под моим столом. Как я делал, так воздал мне Бог.» И привели его в Иерусалим, и он умер там.
ru.B: Адони-Везек сказал: «Семьдесят царей с отрубленными большими пальцами на руках и ногах подбирали объедки под моим столом. Бог отплатил мне за то, что я делал.» Его привели в Иерусалим, и там он умер.
ru.R: Адони-Везек сказал: «Когда-то у меня было семьдесят царей, которым я отрубил большие пальцы на руках и ногах. Они подбирали объедки под моим столом. Теперь Бог сделал со мной то же, что я делал с ними.» Его привели в Иерусалим, и там он умер.

ja.L: そしてアドニ・ベゼクは言った。「手と足の親指を切り落とされた七十人の王たちが、わたしの食卓の下で[くずを]拾い集めていた。わたしがしたとおりに、神はわたしに報いた。」そして彼らは彼をエルサレムに連れて行った。彼はそこで死んだ。
ja.B: アドニ・ベゼクは言った。「かつて七十人の王が、手足の親指を切り落とされて、わたしの食卓の下でくずを拾っていた。わたしがしたことの報いを、神はわたしに返したのだ。」彼らはアドニ・ベゼクをエルサレムに連れて行き、彼はそこで死んだ。
ja.R: アドニ・ベゼクは言いました。「わたしのところには以前、手と足の親指を切り落とされた七十人の王がいた。彼らは、わたしの食卓の下で食べ物のくずを拾わなければならなかった。今、神は、わたしが彼らにしたのと同じことを、わたしにしたのだ。」彼らはアドニ・ベゼクをエルサレムに連れて行きました。彼はそこで死にました。

uk.L: І сказав Адоні-Безек: «Сімдесят царів з відрубаними великими пальцями їхніх рук і їхніх ніг збирали [крихти] під моїм столом. Як я робив, так Бог відплатив мені.» І привели його [до] Єрусалима, і він помер там.
uk.B: Адоні-Безек сказав: «Сімдесят царів з відрубаними великими пальцями на руках і ногах збирали крихти під моїм столом. Бог відплатив мені за те, що я робив.» Його привели до Єрусалима, і він там помер.
uk.R: Адоні-Безек сказав: «Колись у мене було сімдесят царів з відрубаними великими пальцями на руках і ногах. Вони мусили збирати крихти їжі під моїм столом. Тепер Бог зробив мені те, що я робив їм.» Його відвели до Єрусалима, і він там помер.

decisions.choice: as I have done, so God has repaid me: the punishment matches the crime
decisions.reason: Adoni-Bezek himself sees that what was done to him is what he did to others. It is the rule of a like penalty for a like wrong that Israel's law gives (Exodus 21:23-25; Leviticus 24:19-20).

decisions.choice: God: one God, though a Canaanite king is speaking
decisions.reason: The word for God can also mean "gods", but the verb "has repaid" is singular, so the king speaks of one God who has judged him.

decisions.choice: seventy kings ... gathering under my table: conquered rulers kept like dogs
decisions.reason: The kings of the land each ruled one town and the villages around it (Joshua 12:9-24). Seventy may be a round number for a great many. To pick up scraps under a table is what dogs did (Matthew 15:27); the maimed kings were kept alive to be humbled.

decisions.choice: they brought him to Jerusalem: most likely the men of Judah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say who brought him. The men of Judah are the subject of the verses before, and verse 8 tells of their attack on Jerusalem. It could also be his own people, taking him home to die.

decisions.choice: [scraps] (L); scraps (B); scraps of food (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means to gather or pick up; what was gathered under a table can only be the scraps of food that fell from it.

decisions.choice: "[vụn bánh]" (L); "vụn bánh" (B); "từng mẩu thức ăn" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that they were gathering; Vietnamese, like the English, needs to say what they picked up, and Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: the captive king says "ta"
decisions.reason: A defeated king still speaks as a king about the kings he once ruled; "ta" keeps his pride in his own words.

decisions.choice: "하나님" for *Elohim* in the mouth of a Canaanite king, with the honorific
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the ordinary word for God, and the meaning decision reads it as the one God, so Korean uses "하나님" and the honorific, as the narrator would.

decisions.choice: The Canaanite king speaks of God plainly ("神は…報いた", "返したのだ"), without the respect forms the narrator uses
decisions.reason: The respect forms are the narrator's; a defeated Canaanite king would not use them.

source.text: וַיִּלָּחֲמ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַיִּלְכְּד֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וַיַּכּ֖וּהָ לְפִי־חָ֑רֶב וְאֶת־הָעִ֖יר שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And fought [the] sons of Judah against Jerusalem, and they captured it, and they struck it to [the] mouth of [the] sword, and the city they sent in the fire.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it, and they struck it with the edge of the sword, and they set the city on fire.
en.B: The men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They struck it down with the sword and set the city on fire.
en.R: The army of Judah attacked Jerusalem and captured it. They killed its people with their swords and burned the city.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Yuda wakapigana na Yerusalemu, wakautwaa, wakaupiga kwa makali ya upanga, na mji wakauteketeza kwa moto.
sw.B: Watu wa Yuda walipigana na Yerusalemu, wakauteka. Waliupiga kwa upanga, wakauteketeza mji kwa moto.
sw.R: Jeshi la Yuda lilishambulia Yerusalemu na kuuteka. Askari wake waliwaua watu wa mji kwa panga, wakauchoma mji moto.

es.L: Y pelearon los hijos de Judá contra Jerusalén y la tomaron, y la hirieron a filo de espada, y prendieron fuego a la ciudad.
es.B: Los hombres de Judá atacaron Jerusalén y la tomaron. La pasaron a espada y prendieron fuego a la ciudad.
es.R: El ejército de Judá atacó Jerusalén y la conquistó. Mataron a sus habitantes con la espada y quemaron la ciudad.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda combattirent contre Jérusalem et la prirent, et ils la frappèrent du tranchant de l’épée, et ils mirent le feu à la ville.
fr.B: Les hommes de Juda attaquèrent Jérusalem et la prirent. Ils la passèrent au fil de l’épée et mirent le feu à la ville.
fr.R: L’armée de Juda a attaqué Jérusalem et s’en est emparée. Les soldats ont tué ses habitants avec leurs épées et ont brûlé la ville.

vi.L: Và con cái Giu-đa đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem và chiếm được thành, và họ đánh thành bằng lưỡi gươm, và phóng lửa đốt thành.
vi.B: Người Giu-đa tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem và chiếm được thành. Họ dùng gươm đánh giết dân thành và phóng lửa đốt thành.
vi.R: Quân Giu-đa tấn công Giê-ru-sa-lem và chiếm được thành. Họ dùng gươm giết dân trong thành và đốt thành.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 자손이 예루살렘을 쳐서 그것을 점령하였고, 칼날로 그것을 쳤다. 그리고 그 성읍에 불을 놓았다.
ko.B: 유다 사람들은 예루살렘을 공격하여 점령했다. 그들은 칼로 그 성을 쳐부수고 성에 불을 질렀다.
ko.R: 유다 군대는 예루살렘을 공격하여 점령했다. 그들은 칼로 그 성 사람들을 죽이고 성을 불태웠다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Judá lutaram contra Jerusalém, e a tomaram, e a feriram ao fio da espada, e puseram fogo na cidade.
pt.B: Os homens de Judá lutaram contra Jerusalém e a tomaram. Passaram a cidade ao fio da espada e a incendiaram.
pt.R: O exército de Judá atacou Jerusalém e a tomou. Os soldados mataram os moradores com a espada e queimaram a cidade.

am.L: የይሁዳ ልጆችም ኢየሩሳሌምን ወጉ፤ ያዙአትም፤ በሰይፍ ስለትም መቱአት፤ ከተማዪቱንም በእሳት አቃጠሉ።
am.B: የይሁዳ ሰዎች ኢየሩሳሌምን ወግተው ያዙአት። በሰይፍም መቱአት፤ ከተማዪቱንም በእሳት አቃጠሉ።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሠራዊት ኢየሩሳሌምን ወግተው ያዙአት። ሕዝቧን በሰይፍ ገደሉ፤ ከተማዪቱንም አቃጠሉ።

hi.L: और {{gender:यहूदा की सन्तान|यहूदा के पुत्रों}} ने यरूशलेम से युद्ध किया और उसे ले लिया, और उसे तलवार की धार से मारा, और नगर को आग में झोंक दिया।
hi.B: यहूदा के लोगों ने यरूशलेम से युद्ध करके उसे ले लिया। उन्होंने उसे तलवार से मार गिराया और नगर में आग लगा दी।
hi.R: यहूदा की सेना ने यरूशलेम पर हमला करके उसे जीत लिया। उन्होंने वहाँ के लोगों को तलवार से मार डाला और नगर को जला दिया।

ru.L: И сражались {{gender:дети Иуды|сыны Иуды}} против Иерусалима, и взяли его, и поразили его остриём меча, а город предали огню.
ru.B: Воины Иуды напали на Иерусалим и взяли его. Они перебили его жителей мечом и сожгли город.
ru.R: Войско Иуды напало на Иерусалим и захватило его. Воины убили его жителей мечами и сожгли город.

ja.L: そしてユダの子らはエルサレムを攻めて戦い、それを攻め取り、剣の刃でそれを打ち、町に火を放った。
ja.B: ユダの人々はエルサレムを攻めてこれを占領し、町の者を剣にかけ、町に火を放った。
ja.R: ユダの軍はエルサレムを攻めて、町を取りました。そして剣で町の人々を殺し、町を焼きました。

uk.L: І воювали {{gender:нащадки Юди|сини Юди}} проти Єрусалима, і захопили його, і вдарили його вістрям меча, і місто підпалили вогнем.
uk.B: Чоловіки Юди воювали проти Єрусалима і захопили його. Вони вразили його мечем і підпалили місто.
uk.R: Військо Юди напало на Єрусалим і захопило його. Вони вбили його жителів мечами і спалили місто.

decisions.choice: Judah captured Jerusalem: an attack that did not hold the city
decisions.reason: Verse 21 says the Jebusites went on living in Jerusalem, and Joshua 15:63 says Judah could not drive them out. The city was not held by Israel until David took the stronghold (2 Samuel 5:6-9). This verse most likely tells of a raid that took and burned the city, or part of it, without Judah settling there.

decisions.choice: struck it with the edge of the sword: killed its people in battle
decisions.reason: "The mouth of the sword" is the sword's cutting edge, the part that "eats". To strike a city with it is to kill its fighting men and people, as in Joshua 10:28-39.

decisions.choice: the men of Judah (B); the army of Judah (R)
decisions.reason: "Sons of Judah" means the members of the tribe; here it is those who fought, so Balanced says "men" and Readable "army". Literal keeps the tribe's name in the Hebrew form.

decisions.choice: "les enfants de Juda" and "les enfants d'Israël" (L) and "les Israélites" (B, R) as gender-setting defaults, with "fils" as the alternative
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10, as in the Pentateuch: "the sons of Israel" and "the sons of Judah" mean the whole people, so the default is inclusive, "les enfants d'Israël" at Literal and "les Israélites" at Balanced and Readable, with the traditional "fils" as the reader setting. Where Balanced and Readable speak of fighting men, they say "les hommes de Juda" or "l'armée de Juda", as the English does.

decisions.choice: a feriram ao fio da espada (L); passaram a cidade ao fio da espada (B)
alternatives: a feriram à boca da espada
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 1:25; 4:15-16; 18:27; 20:37, 48; 21:10): the idiom (m2) keeps the Portuguese of Genesis 34:26 and Joshua 10:28, "ao fio da espada"; Readable says what it meant, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "поразили остриём меча" (L); "перебили мечом" (B); "убили мечами" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges: the Hebrew says "to the mouth of the sword", the killing of a town's people in battle (m2). Literal keeps the image as "остриё меча"; Balanced and Readable say what was done.

decisions.choice: "struck it with the edge of the sword": "剣の刃で…打ち" (L), "剣にかけ" (B), "剣で…殺し" (R), as Joshua
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2: killed its people in battle; the forms Joshua 8 uses.

source.text: וְאַחַ֗ר יָֽרְדוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם בַּֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָהָ֔ר וְהַנֶּ֖גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And after went down [the] sons of Judah to fight against the Canaanite[s] dwelling [in] the hill country and the Negev and the Shephelah.

en.L: And afterward the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living [in] the hill country and the Negev and the Shephelah.
en.B: After that the men of Judah went down to fight the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the Negev and the foothills.
en.R: After that, the army of Judah went down to fight the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the southern desert, and the low hills in the west.

sw.L: Na baadaye wana wa Yuda wakashuka kupigana na Wakanaani waliokaa [katika] nchi ya milima, na Negebu, na Shefela.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo watu wa Yuda walishuka kupigana na Wakanaani waliokaa katika nchi ya milima, katika Negebu na katika nchi ya vilima vya chini.
sw.R: Baada ya hayo jeshi la Yuda lilishuka kupigana na Wakanaani walioishi katika nchi ya milima, katika jangwa la kusini, na katika vilima vya chini upande wa magharibi.

es.L: Y después descendieron los hijos de Judá a pelear contra los cananeos que habitaban [en] la región montañosa, y el Néguev, y la Sefelá.
es.B: Después los hombres de Judá bajaron a pelear contra los cananeos que vivían en la región montañosa, en el Néguev y en la Sefelá.
es.R: Después el ejército de Judá bajó a pelear contra los cananeos que vivían en la región montañosa, en el desierto del sur y en las colinas bajas del oeste.

fr.L: Et ensuite les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda descendirent pour combattre contre les Cananéens qui habitaient la montagne, et le Néguev, et la Shéphéla.
fr.B: Après cela, les hommes de Juda descendirent combattre les Cananéens qui habitaient la région montagneuse, le Néguev et le Bas-Pays.
fr.R: Ensuite, l’armée de Juda est descendue pour combattre les Cananéens qui vivaient dans la région des collines, dans le désert du sud et dans les basses collines de l’ouest.

vi.L: Và sau đó con cái Giu-đa đi xuống đánh người Ca-na-an sống [ở] vùng đồi núi, và Nê-ghép, và Sê-phê-la.
vi.B: Sau đó, người Giu-đa đi xuống đánh người Ca-na-an sống ở vùng đồi núi, vùng Nê-ghép và vùng đồi thấp.
vi.R: Sau đó, quân Giu-đa đi xuống đánh người Ca-na-an sống ở vùng đồi núi, vùng sa mạc phía nam và vùng đồi thấp phía tây.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 유다 자손이 산지와 네겝과 세벨라에 사는 가나안 사람들과 싸우려고 내려갔다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 유다 사람들은 산지와 네겝과 낮은 구릉 지대에 사는 가나안 사람들과 싸우려고 내려갔다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 유다 군대는 산지와 남쪽 사막과 서쪽의 낮은 언덕 지대에 사는 가나안 사람들과 싸우러 내려갔다.

pt.L: E depois os filhos de Judá desceram para lutar contra os cananeus que habitavam [na] região montanhosa, e no Neguebe, e na Sefelá.
pt.B: Depois disso os homens de Judá desceram para lutar contra os cananeus que moravam na região montanhosa, no Neguebe e nas colinas da Sefelá.
pt.R: Depois disso, o exército de Judá desceu para lutar contra os cananeus que moravam nas montanhas, no deserto do sul e nas colinas baixas do oeste.

am.L: ከዚያም በኋላ የይሁዳ ልጆች በኮረብታማው አገርና በኔጌብ፣ በቆላማውም አገር የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ለመውጋት ወረዱ።
am.B: ከዚያ በኋላ የይሁዳ ሰዎች በኮረብታማው አገር፣ በኔጌብና በቆላማው አገር የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ለመውጋት ወረዱ።
am.R: ከዚያ በኋላ የይሁዳ ሠራዊት በኮረብታማው አገር፣ በደቡቡ ምድረ በዳና በምዕራብ በኩል ባሉት ዝቅተኛ ኮረብቶች የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ለመውጋት ወረዱ።

hi.L: और इसके बाद {{gender:यहूदा की सन्तान|यहूदा के पुत्र}} पहाड़ी देश और नेगेव और शफेला में रहनेवाले कनानियों से लड़ने के लिए उतरे।
hi.B: इसके बाद यहूदा के लोग उन कनानियों से लड़ने के लिए उतरे जो पहाड़ी देश, नेगेव और तराई में रहते थे।
hi.R: इसके बाद यहूदा की सेना उन कनानियों से लड़ने उतरी जो पहाड़ी इलाक़े में, दक्षिण के रेगिस्तान में और पश्चिम की निचली पहाड़ियों में रहते थे।

ru.L: А после того спустились {{gender:дети Иуды|сыны Иуды}} сражаться с хананеями, жившими [в] горной стране, и в Негеве, и в Шефеле.
ru.B: После этого воины Иуды спустились воевать с хананеями, которые жили в горах, в Негеве и в предгорьях.
ru.R: После этого войско Иуды спустилось, чтобы сразиться с хананеями, которые жили в горах, в южной пустыне и в низких холмах на западе.

ja.L: そしてその後、ユダの子らは、山地とネゲブとシェフェラに住むカナン人と戦うために下って行った。
ja.B: その後、ユダの人々は、山地とネゲブと丘陵地に住むカナン人と戦うために下って行った。
ja.R: そのあと、ユダの軍は下って行って、山地や南の荒れ地や西の低い丘に住むカナン人と戦いました。

uk.L: А потім {{gender:нащадки Юди|сини Юди}} зійшли воювати з ханаанеями, що жили [в] горах, і в Негеві, і в Шефелі.
uk.B: Після того чоловіки Юди зійшли воювати з ханаанеями, що жили в горах, у Негеві та в західних передгірʼях.
uk.R: Після того військо Юди зійшло воювати з ханаанеями, що жили в горах, у південній пустелі та в низьких пагорбах на заході.

decisions.choice: the hill country, the Negev, the Shephelah: the three regions of Judah's land
decisions.reason: The hill country is the central ridge; the Negev the dry land to the south; the Shephelah the low hills between the ridge and the coastal plain (Deuteronomy 1:7; Joshua 10:40). The verse names the whole of Judah's territory; verses 10-17 tell of the campaign in it.

decisions.choice: went down: from the heights of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The tribe "goes down" from the high ground around Jerusalem (verse 8) to the lands south and west of it.

decisions.choice: the southern desert, the low hills in the west
decisions.reason: Readable describes the regions instead of naming them, as in Joshua 10:40. For "the army of Judah" see verse 8.

decisions.choice: "la Shéphéla" (L); "le Bas-Pays" (B); "les basses collines de l'ouest" (R)
decisions.reason: The Shephelah is the band of low hills between the mountains of Judah and the coastal plain. Literal keeps the Hebrew name; Balanced uses "le Bas-Pays", a French name for that strip of land; Readable describes it, as the English "the low hills in the west" does.

decisions.choice: "Nê-ghép" (L, B), "vùng sa mạc phía nam" (R); "Sê-phê-la" (L), "vùng đồi thấp" (B), "vùng đồi thấp phía tây" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew names of the regions (m1); Balanced keeps "Negev" as a name and describes the foothills; Readable describes both, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a região montanhosa, o Neguebe, a Sefelá (L); as colinas da Sefelá (B); as montanhas, o deserto do sul, as colinas baixas do oeste (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the three regions (m1) keep the Portuguese of Joshua 10:40, where Balanced says "as colinas da Sefelá" for the English "foothills" and Readable describes them.

decisions.choice: "शफेला" (L); "तराई" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the region's Hebrew name; Balanced says "तराई", the Hindi word for low land at the foot of hills, as the English Balanced says "foothills". Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Негев" (L, B), "южная пустыня" (R); "Шефела" (L), "предгорья" (B), "низкие холмы на западе" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 1:7: the three regions of Judah keep their names at Literal; Balanced says "предгорья" for the Shephelah, and Readable describes each region, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "the Negev" "ネゲブ" (L, B), "南の荒れ地" (R); "the Shephelah" "シェフェラ" (L), "丘陵地" (B), "西の低い丘" (R)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 1:7 in Japanese; Readable describes the regions as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּחֶבְר֔וֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְר֥וֹן לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֑ע וַיַּכּ֛וּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁ֥י וְאֶת־אֲחִימַ֖ן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Judah against the Canaanite[s] dwelling in Hebron, and [the] name of Hebron formerly [was] Kiriath-arba; and they struck Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.
