en.L: And Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron; and the name of Hebron formerly [was] Kiriath-arba; and they struck Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai.
en.B: Judah marched against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron, which used to be called Kiriath-arba, and they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
en.R: Judah attacked the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba. There they defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.

sw.L: Naye Yuda akaenda dhidi ya Wakanaani waliokaa Hebroni; na jina la Hebroni hapo kwanza [lilikuwa] Kiriath-arba; nao wakawapiga Sheshai, na Ahimani, na Talmai.
sw.B: Watu wa Yuda walikwenda kupigana na Wakanaani waliokaa Hebroni, mji ambao zamani uliitwa Kiriath-arba, wakawashinda Sheshai, Ahimani na Talmai.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda waliwashambulia Wakanaani walioishi Hebroni. Zamani Hebroni uliitwa Kiriath-arba. Huko waliwashinda Sheshai, Ahimani na Talmai.

es.L: Y fue Judá contra los cananeos que habitaban en Hebrón, y el nombre de Hebrón antes [era] Quiriat-arbá; e hirieron a Sesai, a Ahimán y a Talmai.
es.B: Judá marchó contra los cananeos que vivían en Hebrón, que antes se llamaba Quiriat-arbá, y derrotaron a Sesai, a Ahimán y a Talmai.
es.R: Judá atacó a los cananeos que vivían en Hebrón. Antes Hebrón se llamaba Quiriat-arbá. Allí derrotaron a Sesai, a Ahimán y a Talmai.

fr.L: Et Juda marcha contre les Cananéens qui habitaient à Hébron ; et le nom d’Hébron autrefois [était] Kiryath-Arba ; et ils frappèrent Shéshaï, et Ahimân, et Talmaï.
fr.B: Juda marcha contre les Cananéens qui habitaient à Hébron, qui s’appelait autrefois Kiryath-Arba, et ils battirent Shéshaï, Ahimân et Talmaï.
fr.R: Les hommes de Juda ont attaqué les Cananéens qui vivaient à Hébron. Autrefois, Hébron s’appelait Kiryath-Arba. Là, ils ont battu Shéshaï, Ahimân et Talmaï.

vi.L: Và Giu-đa đi đánh người Ca-na-an sống tại Hếp-rôn; và tên của Hếp-rôn trước kia [là] Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba; và họ đánh giết Sê-sai, A-hi-man và Thanh-mai.
vi.B: Giu-đa tiến đánh người Ca-na-an sống tại Hếp-rôn, trước kia gọi là Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba, và họ đánh bại Sê-sai, A-hi-man và Thanh-mai.
vi.R: Quân Giu-đa tấn công người Ca-na-an sống tại Hếp-rôn. Trước kia Hếp-rôn có tên là Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba. Tại đó họ đánh bại Sê-sai, A-hi-man và Thanh-mai.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 헤브론에 사는 가나안 사람들에게로 갔다. 헤브론의 이름은 전에 기럇아르바[였다]. 그리고 그들이 세새와 아히만과 달매를 쳤다.
ko.B: 유다는 헤브론에 사는 가나안 사람들을 치러 갔다. 헤브론은 전에 기럇아르바라고 불렸다. 그들은 세새와 아히만과 달매를 쳐부수었다.
ko.R: 유다는 헤브론에 사는 가나안 사람들을 공격했다. 헤브론의 옛 이름은 기럇아르바였다. 거기서 그들은 세새와 아히만과 달매를 무찔렀다.

pt.L: E Judá foi contra os cananeus que habitavam em Hebrom; e o nome de Hebrom antes [era] Quiriate-Arba; e feriram Sesai, e Aimã, e Talmai.
pt.B: Judá marchou contra os cananeus que moravam em Hebrom, que antigamente se chamava Quiriate-Arba, e derrotaram Sesai, Aimã e Talmai.
pt.R: Judá atacou os cananeus que moravam em Hebrom. O nome antigo de Hebrom era Quiriate-Arba. Ali eles derrotaram Sesai, Aimã e Talmai.

am.L: ይሁዳም በኬብሮን በሚኖሩት ከነዓናውያን ላይ ሄደ፤ የኬብሮንም ስም ቀድሞ ቂርያት አርባ [ነበረ]፤ ሴሲንና አኪመንን ተላሚንም መቱ።
am.B: ይሁዳ ቀድሞ ቂርያት አርባ ትባል በነበረችው በኬብሮን በሚኖሩት ከነዓናውያን ላይ ዘመተ፤ ሴሲን፣ አኪመንንና ተላሚንም ድል አደረጉ።
am.R: ይሁዳ በኬብሮን የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ወጋ። ኬብሮን ቀድሞ ቂርያት አርባ ትባል ነበር። በዚያም ሴሲን፣ አኪመንንና ተላሚን ድል አደረጉ።

hi.L: और यहूदा हेब्रोन में रहनेवाले कनानियों पर चढ़ गया; और पहले हेब्रोन का नाम किर्यत-अर्बा [था]; और उन्होंने शेशै और अहीमन और तल्मै को मारा।
hi.B: यहूदा ने हेब्रोन में रहनेवाले कनानियों पर चढ़ाई की, जिसका नाम पहले किर्यत-अर्बा था, और उन्होंने शेशै, अहीमन और तल्मै को हरा दिया।
hi.R: यहूदा ने हेब्रोन में रहनेवाले कनानियों पर हमला किया। पहले हेब्रोन को किर्यत-अर्बा कहते थे। वहाँ उन्होंने शेशै, अहीमन और तल्मै को हरा दिया।

ru.L: И пошёл Иуда против хананеев, живших в Хевроне, — а имя Хеврона прежде [было] Кирьят-Арба, — и поразили Шешая, и Ахимана, и Фалмая.
ru.B: Иуда выступил против хананеев, живших в Хевроне, который прежде назывался Кирьят-Арба, и они разбили Шешая, Ахимана и Фалмая.
ru.R: Колено Иуды напало на хананеев, которые жили в Хевроне. Раньше Хеврон назывался Кирьят-Арба. Там они разбили Шешая, Ахимана и Фалмая.

ja.L: そしてユダはヘブロンに住むカナン人に向かって行った。ヘブロンの名は以前はキルヤト・アルバであった。そして彼らはシェシャイとアヒマンとタルマイを打った。
ja.B: ユダはヘブロンに住むカナン人に向かって進んだ。ヘブロンは以前、キルヤト・アルバと呼ばれていた。彼らはシェシャイ、アヒマン、タルマイを打ち破った。
ja.R: ユダはヘブロンに住むカナン人を攻めました。ヘブロンは、昔はキルヤト・アルバと呼ばれていました。そこでユダは、シェシャイとアヒマンとタルマイを打ち負かしました。

uk.L: І пішов Юда на ханаанеїв, що жили в Хевроні; а імʼя Хеврона раніше [було] Кіріят-Арба; і побили Шешая, і Ахімана, і Талмая.
uk.B: Юда виступив проти ханаанеїв, що жили в Хевроні, який колись називався Кіріят-Арба, і вони розбили Шешая, Ахімана і Талмая.
uk.R: Юда напав на ханаанеїв, що жили в Хевроні. Колись Хеврон називався Кіріят-Арба. Там вони розбили Шешая, Ахімана і Талмая.

decisions.choice: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai: the sons of Anak whom Caleb drove out
decisions.reason: Joshua 15:13-14 tells the same victory as Caleb's, and verse 20 here says it too: Caleb, of the tribe of Judah, drove out these three sons of Anak. The scouts had seen them at Hebron forty-five years before (Numbers 13:22). Here the deed is counted to Judah as a tribe. "Sons" may mean clans as well as men, as at Joshua 15:14.

decisions.choice: Kiriath-arba: "the town of Arba"
decisions.reason: As at Joshua 14:15 and 15:13, the old name means the town of Arba, the greatest man of the Anakim and father of Anak.

decisions.choice: "watu wa Yuda" (the people of Judah) where a tribe acts as a group, through these chapters
decisions.reason: Hebrew names a tribe as one person ("Judah went"), and Literal keeps that. Swahili Balanced and Readable say "watu wa Yuda", "watu wa Efraimu" when the tribe acts with plural verbs, so that the reader does not take the name for one man. Where only the two ancestors are pictured (Judah and his brother Simeon, verses 3 and 17), Balanced keeps the names.

decisions.choice: Quiriate-Arba; Sesai, Aimã, Talmai; and in verses 11-15 the wording of Joshua 15:13-19
alternatives: Sesai, Aimã e Talmai written differently
decisions.reason: Verses 10-15 tell again what Joshua 15:13-19 tells (m1 here; m1 on verse 11), so the Portuguese keeps the names and the wording of those verses where the Hebrew is the same: Quiriate-Arba, Sesai, Aimã, Talmai, Debir, Quiriate-Sefer, Otniel, filho de Quenaz, Acsa, and Achsah's "o senhor" to her father.

decisions.choice: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai are "ሴሲ", "አኪመን" and "ተላሚ", the forms of Numbers 13:22; Kiriath-arba is "ቂርያት አርባ", as Genesis 23:2.
decisions.reason: The same men and the same town as in the Pentateuch keep the same names.

source.text: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑יר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִ֥יר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־סֵֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went from there against [the] inhabitants of Debir; and [the] name of Debir formerly [was] Kiriath-sepher.

en.L: And he went from there against the inhabitants of Debir; and the name of Debir formerly [was] Kiriath-sepher.
en.B: From there they went against the people who lived in Debir. Debir used to be called Kiriath-sepher.
en.R: From there the army of Judah went to attack the people of Debir. Debir's old name was Kiriath-sepher.

sw.L: Naye akaenda kutoka huko dhidi ya wenyeji wa Debiri; na jina la Debiri hapo kwanza [lilikuwa] Kiriath-seferi.
sw.B: Kutoka huko walikwenda kupigana na watu waliokaa Debiri. Zamani Debiri uliitwa Kiriath-seferi.
sw.R: Kutoka huko jeshi la Yuda lilikwenda kuwashambulia watu wa Debiri. Jina la zamani la Debiri lilikuwa Kiriath-seferi.

es.L: Y fue de allí contra los habitantes de Debir; y el nombre de Debir antes [era] Quiriat-séfer.
es.B: De allí fueron contra los habitantes de Debir. Debir antes se llamaba Quiriat-séfer.
es.R: De allí el ejército de Judá fue a atacar a la gente de Debir. El nombre antiguo de Debir era Quiriat-séfer.

fr.L: Et il marcha de là contre les habitants de Debir ; et le nom de Debir autrefois [était] Kiryath-Sépher.
fr.B: De là, ils marchèrent contre les habitants de Debir. Debir s’appelait autrefois Kiryath-Sépher.
fr.R: De là, l’armée de Juda est allée attaquer les habitants de Debir. L’ancien nom de Debir était Kiryath-Sépher.

vi.L: Và từ đó ông đi đánh dân cư Đê-bia; và tên của Đê-bia trước kia [là] Ki-ri-át Sê-phe.
vi.B: Từ đó họ tiến đánh dân cư Đê-bia. Trước kia Đê-bia có tên là Ki-ri-át Sê-phe.
vi.R: Từ đó quân Giu-đa đi tấn công dân thành Đê-bia. Tên cũ của Đê-bia là Ki-ri-át Sê-phe.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 거기서 드빌의 주민들에게로 갔다. 드빌의 이름은 전에 기럇세벨[이었다].
ko.B: 그들은 거기서 드빌에 사는 사람들을 치러 갔다. 드빌은 전에 기럇세벨이라고 불렸다.
ko.R: 유다 군대는 거기서 드빌 사람들을 공격하러 갔다. 드빌의 옛 이름은 기럇세벨이었다.

pt.L: E ele foi dali contra os habitantes de Debir; e o nome de Debir antes [era] Quiriate-Sefer.
pt.B: Dali eles foram contra os moradores de Debir. Antigamente Debir se chamava Quiriate-Sefer.
pt.R: Dali o exército de Judá foi atacar o povo de Debir. O nome antigo de Debir era Quiriate-Sefer.

am.L: ከዚያም በዳቤር ነዋሪዎች ላይ ሄደ፤ የዳቤርም ስም ቀድሞ ቂርያት ሤፈር [ነበረ]።
am.B: ከዚያ ተነሥተው በዳቤር በሚኖሩት ሰዎች ላይ ዘመቱ። ዳቤር ቀድሞ ቂርያት ሤፈር ትባል ነበር።
am.R: የይሁዳ ሠራዊት ከዚያ ተነሥተው የዳቤርን ሰዎች ለመውጋት ሄዱ። የዳቤር የቀድሞ ስም ቂርያት ሤፈር ነበር።

hi.L: और वहाँ से वह दबीर के निवासियों पर चढ़ गया; और पहले दबीर का नाम किर्यत-सेपेर [था]।
hi.B: वहाँ से उन्होंने दबीर में रहनेवालों पर चढ़ाई की। दबीर का नाम पहले किर्यत-सेपेर था।
hi.R: वहाँ से यहूदा की सेना दबीर के लोगों पर हमला करने गई। दबीर का पुराना नाम किर्यत-सेपेर था।

ru.L: И пошёл он оттуда против жителей Девира, а имя Девира прежде [было] Кирьят-Сефер.
ru.B: Оттуда они пошли против жителей Девира. Прежде Девир назывался Кирьят-Сефер.
ru.R: Оттуда войско Иуды пошло воевать с жителями Девира. Раньше Девир назывался Кирьят-Сефер.

ja.L: そして彼はそこからデビルの住民に向かって行った。デビルの名は以前はキルヤト・セフェルであった。
ja.B: 彼らはそこから、デビルに住む人々に向かって行った。デビルは以前、キルヤト・セフェルと呼ばれていた。
ja.R: ユダの軍は、そこからデビルの人々を攻めに行きました。デビルの昔の名前は、キルヤト・セフェルでした。

uk.L: І пішов він звідти проти мешканців Девіра; а імʼя Девіра раніше [було] Кіріят-Сефер.
uk.B: Звідти вони пішли проти жителів Девіра. Колись Девір називався Кіріят-Сефер.
uk.R: Звідти військо Юди пішло нападати на жителів Девіра. Давня назва Девіра була Кіріят-Сефер.

decisions.choice: the story told also in Joshua 15:15-19
decisions.reason: Verses 11-15 repeat Joshua 15:15-19 almost word for word. Here the attack on Debir is part of Judah's campaign in the south (verses 9-10).

decisions.choice: Debir, once Kiriath-sepher: a town in the hills south-west of Hebron
decisions.reason: Kiriath-sepher means "town of the book" or "town of the scribe". Joshua had struck Debir before (Joshua 10:38-39), but it had to be taken again.

decisions.choice: they (B); the army of Judah (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he", meaning Judah as one person. Balanced says "they" and Readable names Judah's army.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Caleb, [The one] who strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, and I will give to him Achsah my daughter as a wife.

en.L: And Caleb said, "Whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
en.B: Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Achsah as a wife to the man who attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it."
en.R: Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Achsah to be the wife of the man who attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it."

sw.L: Naye Kalebu akasema, "Yeye atakayeupiga Kiriath-seferi na kuutwaa, nitampa Aksa binti yangu kuwa mke."
sw.B: Kalebu alisema, "Nitampa binti yangu Aksa awe mke wa mtu atakayeushambulia Kiriath-seferi na kuuteka."
sw.R: Kalebu alisema, "Mtu atakayeushambulia mji wa Kiriath-seferi na kuuteka, nitampa binti yangu Aksa awe mke wake."

es.L: Y dijo Caleb: «Al que hiera a Quiriat-séfer y la tome, le daré a Acsa mi hija por mujer.»
es.B: Caleb dijo: «Al hombre que ataque Quiriat-séfer y la tome, le daré por esposa a mi hija Acsa.»
es.R: Caleb dijo: «Daré a mi hija Acsa como esposa al hombre que ataque Quiriat-séfer y la conquiste.»

fr.L: Et Caleb dit : « Celui qui frappera Kiryath-Sépher et la prendra, je lui donnerai Aksa, ma fille, pour femme. »
fr.B: Caleb dit : « Je donnerai ma fille Aksa pour femme à celui qui attaquera Kiryath-Sépher et s’en emparera. »
fr.R: Caleb a dit : « Celui qui attaquera Kiryath-Sépher et prendra la ville, je lui donnerai ma fille Aksa pour qu’elle soit sa femme. »

vi.L: Và Ca-lép nói: "Ai đánh Ki-ri-át Sê-phe và chiếm được thành, ta sẽ gả Ạc-sa, con gái ta, cho người ấy làm vợ."
vi.B: Ca-lép nói: "Ta sẽ gả Ạc-sa, con gái ta, cho người nào tấn công và chiếm được Ki-ri-át Sê-phe."
vi.R: Ca-lép nói: "Ai tấn công và chiếm được Ki-ri-át Sê-phe, ta sẽ gả con gái ta là Ạc-sa cho người ấy làm vợ."

ko.L: 그리고 갈렙이 말했다. "기럇세벨을 쳐서 그것을 점령하는 사람에게 내가 내 딸 악사를 아내로 주겠다."
ko.B: 갈렙이 말했다. "기럇세벨을 쳐서 점령하는 사람에게 내 딸 악사를 아내로 주겠다."
ko.R: 갈렙이 말했다. "기럇세벨을 공격하여 점령하는 사람에게 내 딸 악사를 아내로 주겠다."

pt.L: E Calebe disse: "Quem ferir Quiriate-Sefer e a tomar, eu lhe darei Acsa, minha filha, por mulher."
pt.B: Calebe disse: "Ao homem que atacar Quiriate-Sefer e a conquistar, eu darei a minha filha Acsa como esposa."
pt.R: Calebe disse: "Vou dar a minha filha Acsa como esposa ao homem que atacar Quiriate-Sefer e conquistar a cidade."

am.L: ካሌብም፦ «ቂርያት ሤፈርን መትቶ ለሚይዛት፣ ልጄን ዓክሳን ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ እሰጠዋለሁ።» አለ።
am.B: ካሌብም፦ «ቂርያት ሤፈርን ወግቶ ለሚይዛት ሰው ልጄን ዓክሳን ሚስት አድርጌ እሰጠዋለሁ።» አለ።
am.R: ካሌብ፦ «ቂርያት ሤፈርን አጥቅቶ የሚይዛትን ሰው ልጄን ዓክሳን አጋባዋለሁ።» አለ።

hi.L: और कालेब ने कहा, "जो कोई किर्यत-सेपेर को मारे और उसे ले ले, उसे मैं अपनी बेटी अकसा पत्नी होने के लिए दूँगा।"
hi.B: कालेब ने कहा, "जो पुरुष किर्यत-सेपेर पर हमला करके उसे ले लेगा, उसे मैं अपनी बेटी अकसा पत्नी के रूप में दूँगा।"
hi.R: कालेब ने कहा, "जो आदमी किर्यत-सेपेर पर हमला करके उसे जीत लेगा, उससे मैं अपनी बेटी अकसा का ब्याह कर दूँगा।"

ru.L: И сказал Халев: «Кто поразит Кирьят-Сефер и возьмёт его, тому я дам Ахсу, мою дочь, в жёны.»
ru.B: Халев сказал: «Тому, кто нападёт на Кирьят-Сефер и возьмёт его, я отдам в жёны мою дочь Ахсу.»
ru.R: Халев сказал: «Кто нападёт на Кирьят-Сефер и захватит его, за того я выдам замуж мою дочь Ахсу.»

ja.L: そしてカレブは言った。「キルヤト・セフェルを打ち、それを攻め取る者に、わたしは娘アクサを妻として与えよう。」
ja.B: カレブは言った。「キルヤト・セフェルを攻めて、これを攻め取る者に、わたしの娘アクサを妻として与えよう。」
ja.R: カレブは言いました。「キルヤト・セフェルを攻めて、その町を取った人に、わたしの娘のアクサを妻として与えよう。」

uk.L: І сказав Калев: «Хто вдарить Кіріят-Сефер і захопить його, тому дам Ахсу, мою дочку, за жінку.»
uk.B: Калев сказав: «Тому, хто нападе на Кіріят-Сефер і захопить його, я дам мою дочку Ахсу за жінку.»
uk.R: Калев сказав: «Я віддам мою дочку Ахсу за жінку тому, хто нападе на Кіріят-Сефер і захопить його.»

decisions.choice: I will give him my daughter as a wife: a bride as the reward for a deed of war
decisions.reason: A father arranged his daughter's marriage. Offering her to the man who won a hard battle honored the winner and bound him to the family, as Saul's offer for killing Goliath did (1 Samuel 17:25; 18:17).

decisions.choice: the same words as Joshua 15:16
decisions.reason: Caleb's offer is given in the same words in Joshua 15:16, and the wording here follows that verse.

decisions.choice: "gả ... cho người ấy làm vợ"
decisions.reason: "gả" is the verb for a father giving his daughter in marriage, which is what "I will give him ... as a wife" means (m1).

decisions.choice: Achsah "アクサ"; Caleb "カレブ" as Numbers and Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: The usual Japanese form of the name.

source.text: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָהּ֙ עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַקָּטֹ֣ן מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And captured it Othniel son of Kenaz, brother of Caleb, the younger than him; and he gave to him Achsah his daughter as a wife.

en.L: And Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, younger than he, captured it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
en.B: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, captured it, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah as his wife.
en.R: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, captured the town. So Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah to be his wife.

sw.L: Naye Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu ya Kalebu, mdogo kuliko yeye, akautwaa; naye akampa Aksa binti yake kuwa mke.
sw.B: Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa Kalebu, aliuteka, basi Kalebu akampa binti yake Aksa awe mke wake.
sw.R: Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa Kalebu, aliuteka mji huo. Basi Kalebu akampa binti yake Aksa awe mke wake.

es.L: Y la tomó Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, hermano de Caleb, menor que él; y le dio a Acsa su hija por mujer.
es.B: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, el hermano menor de Caleb, la tomó, y Caleb le dio por esposa a su hija Acsa.
es.R: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, el hermano menor de Caleb, conquistó la ciudad. Así que Caleb le dio a su hija Acsa como esposa.

fr.L: Et Otniel, fils de Kenaz, frère de Caleb, plus jeune que lui, la prit ; et il lui donna Aksa, sa fille, pour femme.
fr.B: Otniel, fils de Kenaz et frère cadet de Caleb, s’en empara, et Caleb lui donna sa fille Aksa pour femme.
fr.R: C’est Otniel, fils de Kenaz, le frère plus jeune de Caleb, qui a pris la ville. Alors Caleb lui a donné sa fille Aksa, et elle est devenue sa femme.

vi.L: Và Ốt-ni-ên, con trai Kê-na, em của Ca-lép, nhỏ hơn ông, chiếm được thành; và ông gả Ạc-sa, con gái mình, cho người làm vợ.
vi.B: Ốt-ni-ên, con trai Kê-na, em của Ca-lép, chiếm được thành, nên Ca-lép gả con gái mình là Ạc-sa cho người làm vợ.
vi.R: Ốt-ni-ên, con trai Kê-na, là em của Ca-lép, chiếm được thành. Vậy Ca-lép gả con gái mình là Ạc-sa cho Ốt-ni-ên làm vợ.

ko.L: 그리고 갈렙의 아우, 그보다 어린 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 그것을 점령하였다. 그래서 그가 그에게 자기 딸 악사를 아내로 주었다.
ko.B: 갈렙의 아우인 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 그 성을 점령했다. 그래서 갈렙은 자기 딸 악사를 그에게 아내로 주었다.
ko.R: 갈렙의 아우인 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 그 성읍을 점령했다. 그래서 갈렙은 자기 딸 악사를 옷니엘의 아내로 주었다.

pt.L: E Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe, mais novo do que ele, a tomou; e ele lhe deu Acsa, sua filha, por mulher.
pt.B: Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão mais novo de Calebe, a conquistou, e Calebe lhe deu a sua filha Acsa como esposa.
pt.R: Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão mais novo de Calebe, conquistou a cidade. Então Calebe lhe deu a sua filha Acsa para ser a esposa dele.

am.L: ከእርሱም የሚያንሰው የካሌብ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ልጁንም ዓክሳን ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ሰጠው።
am.B: የካሌብ ታናሽ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ያዛት፤ ስለዚህ ካሌብ ልጁን ዓክሳን ሚስት አድርጎ ሰጠው።
am.R: የካሌብ ታናሽ ወንድም የቄኔዝ ልጅ ጎቶንያል ከተማዪቱን ያዘ። ስለዚህ ካሌብ ልጁን ዓክሳን ሚስት እንድትሆነው ሰጠው።

hi.L: और कालेब के छोटे भाई कनज़ के पुत्र ओत्नीएल ने उसे ले लिया; और उसने अपनी बेटी अकसा उसे पत्नी होने के लिए दे दी।
hi.B: कालेब के छोटे भाई, कनज़ के पुत्र ओत्नीएल ने उसे ले लिया, इसलिए कालेब ने अपनी बेटी अकसा उसे पत्नी के रूप में दे दी।
hi.R: कालेब के छोटे भाई, कनज़ के पुत्र ओत्नीएल ने वह नगर जीत लिया। इसलिए कालेब ने अपनी बेटी अकसा का ब्याह उससे कर दिया।

ru.L: И взял его Гофониил, сын Кеназа, брат Халева, младший его; и он дал ему Ахсу, свою дочь, в жёны.
ru.B: Его взял Гофониил, сын Кеназа, младший брат Халева, и Халев отдал ему в жёны свою дочь Ахсу.
ru.R: Гофониил, сын Кеназа, младший брат Халева, захватил этот город. И Халев выдал за него замуж свою дочь Ахсу.

ja.L: そしてカレブの兄弟で彼より年下の、ケナズの子オトニエルがそれを攻め取った。そして彼は娘アクサを彼に妻として与えた。
ja.B: カレブの弟であるケナズの子オトニエルが、これを攻め取った。そこでカレブは、娘アクサを彼の妻として与えた。
ja.R: カレブの弟で、ケナズの息子であるオトニエルが、その町を取りました。それでカレブは、娘のアクサをオトニエルの妻にしました。

uk.L: І захопив його Отніїл, син Кеназа, брат Калева, молодший від нього; і він дав йому Ахсу, свою дочку, за жінку.
uk.B: Отніїл, син Кеназа, молодший брат Калева, захопив його, тож Калев дав йому свою дочку Ахсу за жінку.
uk.R: Отніїл, син Кеназа, молодший брат Калева, захопив місто. Тож Калев віддав йому свою дочку Ахсу за жінку.

decisions.choice: Caleb's younger brother: most likely Othniel, possibly his father Kenaz
decisions.reason: The words "the brother of Caleb, younger than he" could describe Othniel or Kenaz. They are most naturally read of Othniel, as in 3:9. "Brother" may also mean a close relative of the same clan (Joshua 15:17).

decisions.choice: Othniel: later the first of the judges
decisions.reason: Othniel will rescue Israel from the king of Aram-naharaim and lead it for forty years (3:9-11).

decisions.choice: Caleb gave
decisions.reason: As in Joshua 15:17, Balanced and Readable name Caleb as the one who gave, since "he" could be read as Othniel.

decisions.choice: "em của Ca-lép"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say older or younger brother; the Hebrew says "the younger than him", so "em" is exact. As the meaning decision m1 says, the words may describe Kenaz rather than Othniel, which Vietnamese, like the English, leaves open at Literal.

decisions.choice: Otniel, filho de Quenaz
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 3:9, 11), as Joshua 15:17 has the name in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: "Гофониил"
decisions.reason: The traditional Russian Bible form of the name, kept for the whole of Judges, as the history note keeps the traditional forms of names (Иеффай, Самсон).

decisions.choice: Othniel "オトニエル"; "the brother of Caleb, younger than he": "カレブの兄弟で彼より年下の" (L), "カレブの弟" (B, R), placed so that it can, like the Hebrew, belong to Othniel
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: most likely Othniel is Caleb's younger brother; the Japanese order keeps the phrase next to Othniel.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֨הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־אָבִ֨יהָ֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־לָּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when she came, and she urged him to ask from her father the field; and she got down from on the donkey, and said to her Caleb, What to you?

en.L: And it happened, when she came, that she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she got down from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What [do] you [want]?"
en.B: When she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she got down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What do you want?"
en.R: When Achsah came to be Othniel's wife, she urged him to ask her father for a field. Then she got down from her donkey, and Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

sw.L: Ikawa alipokuja, akamhimiza amwombe baba yake shamba. Naye akashuka kutoka juu ya punda, naye Kalebu akamwambia, "[Unataka] nini?"
sw.B: Alipokuja kwa Othnieli, alimhimiza amwombe baba yake shamba. Aliposhuka kutoka juu ya punda wake, Kalebu alimwuliza, "Unataka nini?"
sw.R: Aksa alipokuja kuwa mke wa Othnieli, alimhimiza amwombe baba yake shamba. Kisha akashuka kutoka juu ya punda wake, naye Kalebu akamwuliza, "Nikusaidie nini?"

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando ella llegó, lo persuadió para que pidiera a su padre un campo. Y ella se bajó del asno, y Caleb le dijo: «¿Qué [quieres]?»
es.B: Cuando ella llegó a donde estaba Otoniel, lo animó a pedirle un campo a su padre. Al bajarse ella de su asno, Caleb le preguntó: «¿Qué quieres?»
es.R: Cuando Acsa llegó para ser la esposa de Otoniel, lo animó a pedirle un campo a su padre. Luego ella se bajó de su burro, y Caleb le preguntó: «¿Qué puedo hacer por ti?»

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand elle vint, [qu’]elle le pressa de demander à son père un champ. Et elle descendit de dessus l’âne, et Caleb lui dit : « Qu’as-tu ? »
fr.B: Quand elle vint chez Otniel, elle le pressa de demander un champ à son père. Comme elle descendait de son âne, Caleb lui demanda : « Que veux-tu ? »
fr.R: Quand Aksa est venue vivre avec Otniel comme sa femme, elle l’a poussé à demander un champ à son père. Puis elle est descendue de son âne, et Caleb lui a demandé : « Que puis-je faire pour toi ? »

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi nàng đến, nàng giục người xin cha nàng một cánh đồng. Và nàng tụt xuống khỏi lưng lừa, và Ca-lép nói với nàng: "Con [muốn] gì?"
vi.B: Khi về nhà Ốt-ni-ên, nàng giục chồng xin cha mình một cánh đồng. Lúc nàng xuống lừa, Ca-lép hỏi: "Con muốn gì?"
vi.R: Khi Ạc-sa về làm vợ Ốt-ni-ên, nàng giục chồng xin cha mình một cánh đồng. Rồi nàng xuống lừa, và Ca-lép hỏi nàng: "Cha có thể làm gì cho con?"

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 [그에게] 올 때에 그를 졸라 자기 아버지에게 밭을 달라고 하게 하였다. 그리고 그 여자가 나귀에서 내리자 갈렙이 그 여자에게 말했다. "너는 무엇을 [원하느냐]?"
ko.B: 악사는 옷니엘에게 올 때에 그를 졸라 자기 아버지에게 밭을 하나 달라고 하게 했다. 악사가 나귀에서 내리자 갈렙이 물었다. "무엇을 원하느냐?"
ko.R: 악사는 옷니엘의 아내가 되려고 올 때에, 아버지에게 밭을 달라고 하라며 남편을 졸랐다. 악사가 나귀에서 내리자 갈렙이 물었다. "내가 무엇을 해 주면 좋겠느냐?"

pt.L: E aconteceu, quando ela veio, que ela o instigou a pedir ao pai dela um campo; e ela desceu depressa do jumento, e Calebe lhe disse: "O que [você quer]?"
pt.B: Quando ela foi para a casa de Otniel, insistiu com ele para que pedisse um campo ao pai dela. Assim que ela desceu do jumento, Calebe lhe perguntou: "O que você quer?"
pt.R: Quando Acsa foi viver com Otniel como esposa, ela insistiu com ele para que pedisse um campo ao pai dela. Depois ela desceu do jumento, e Calebe lhe perguntou: "O que posso fazer por você?"

am.L: እርሷም በመጣች ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከአባቷ እርሻ እንዲለምን ገፋፋችው፤ ከአህያዪቱም ላይ ወረደች፤ ካሌብም፦ «ምን [ፈለግሽ]?» አላት።
am.B: ወደ ጎቶንያል በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባቷ እርሻ እንዲለምን ገፋፋችው። ከአህያዋም ስትወርድ ካሌብ፦ «ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ?» ብሎ ጠየቃት።
am.R: ዓክሳ የጎቶንያል ሚስት ልትሆን በመጣች ጊዜ ከአባቷ እርሻ እንዲጠይቅ ገፋፋችው። ከዚያም ከአህያዋ ወረደች፤ ካሌብም፦ «ምን ላድርግልሽ?» ብሎ ጠየቃት።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब वह आई, तो उसने उसे उभारा कि वह उसके पिता से एक खेत माँगे। और वह गधे पर से उतरी, और कालेब ने उससे कहा, "तुम [क्या चाहती हो]?"
hi.B: जब वह ओत्नीएल के पास आई, तो उसने उसे उभारा कि वह उसके पिता से एक खेत माँगे। जब वह अपने गधे से उतरी, तो कालेब ने उससे पूछा, "तुम क्या चाहती हो?"
hi.R: जब अकसा ओत्नीएल की पत्नी बनकर आई, तो उसने ओत्नीएल से कहा कि वह उसके पिता से एक खेत माँगे। फिर वह अपने गधे से उतरी, और कालेब ने उससे पूछा, "बताओ, मैं तुम्हारे लिए क्या करूँ?"

ru.L: И было, когда она пришла, она уговорила его просить у её отца поле. И она спустилась с осла, и сказал ей Халев: «Что тебе?»
ru.B: Когда она пришла к Гофониилу, она уговорила его попросить у её отца поле. Она соскочила с осла, и Халев спросил её: «Чего ты хочешь?»
ru.R: Когда Ахса пришла к Гофониилу, чтобы стать его женой, она уговорила его попросить у её отца поле. Потом она слезла с осла, и Халев спросил её: «Что я могу для тебя сделать?»

ja.L: そして彼女が来たとき、彼女は父に畑を求めるように彼を促した。そして彼女がろばから降りると、カレブは彼女に言った。「何が[欲しいのか]？」
ja.B: 彼女はオトニエルのもとに来たとき、父に畑を求めるよう夫を促した。彼女がろばから降りると、カレブは「何が欲しいのか？」と尋ねた。
ja.R: アクサはオトニエルの妻になるために来たとき、父に畑をもらうよう夫に勧めました。アクサがろばから降りると、カレブは「何かしてほしいことがあるのか？」と聞きました。

uk.L: І сталося, коли вона прийшла, то намовила його просити в її батька поле. І вона зіскочила з осла, і сказав їй Калев: «Що тобі?»
uk.B: Коли вона прийшла до Отніїла, то намовила його попросити в її батька поле. Коли вона злізла з осла, Калев спитав її: «Чого ти хочеш?»
uk.R: Коли Ахса прийшла, щоб стати жінкою Отніїла, вона намовила його попросити в її батька поле. Потім вона злізла з осла, і Калев спитав її: «Що я можу для тебе зробити?»

decisions.choice: when she came: when she came to her husband as a bride
decisions.reason: Her coming is her arrival at Othniel's home at the marriage, as at Joshua 15:18. Her request may belong to the gift a father gave with his daughter when she married.

decisions.choice: she urged him: Achsah urged Othniel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "she urged him", here and in Joshua 15:18. The ancient Greek translation reads "he urged her", so that Othniel prompts Achsah to ask. The Hebrew is followed, since in verse 15 Achsah makes the request herself. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: she got down: slipped down quickly from the donkey
decisions.reason: The verb is rare (Joshua 15:18; Judges 4:21). It seems to mean a quick downward movement; getting down before an older man showed respect before a request (Genesis 24:64; 1 Samuel 25:23). Some take it to mean that she clapped her hands or called out.

decisions.choice: what to you?: what do you want?
decisions.reason: The short question asks what a person wishes or needs, as in 1 Kings 1:16.

decisions.choice: to Othniel (B); Achsah came to be Othniel's wife (R)
decisions.reason: As in Joshua 15:18, Balanced and Readable name the people the pronouns point to, and Readable says what her coming was (m1). Readable gives Caleb's question as a father's kind offer of help.

decisions.choice: Caleb calls his daughter "con"; she calls him "cha" (15)
decisions.reason: Parent and child speak as "cha" and "con", as the Genesis note sets.

decisions.choice: Caleb speaks to his daughter in the plain style (해라체); she answers in the polite style with "아버지"
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for parent and child.

decisions.choice: Caleb and his daughter say "አንቺ" and "አንተ" to each other.
alternatives: "እርስዎ" from the daughter to her father
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, family members, parents included, use the familiar "you"; her respect is carried by her request.

source.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜וֹ הָֽבָה־לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֨גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָ֣הּ כָּלֵ֗ב אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּ֔ית וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּֽית׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And she said to him, Give to me a blessing; for [the] land of the Negev you have given me, and you shall give to me springs of water. And gave to her Caleb upper springs and lower springs.

en.L: And she said to him, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me the land of the Negev, give me also springs of water." And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
en.B: She answered, "Give me a gift. You have given me land in the Negev; now give me springs of water too." Caleb then gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
en.R: She answered, "Please give me a gift. You have given me land in the dry south country, so give me some springs of water too." So Caleb gave her the upper and the lower springs.

sw.L: Naye akamwambia, "Nipe baraka; kwa kuwa umenipa nchi ya Negebu, nipe pia chemchemi za maji." Naye Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na chemchemi za chini.
sw.B: Alijibu, "Nipe zawadi. Umenipa ardhi katika Negebu; sasa nipe na chemchemi za maji pia." Basi Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na chemchemi za chini.
sw.R: Alijibu, "Tafadhali nipe zawadi. Umenipa ardhi katika nchi kavu ya kusini, kwa hiyo nipe pia chemchemi za maji." Basi Kalebu akampa chemchemi za juu na za chini.

es.L: Y ella le dijo: «Dame una bendición; ya que me has dado la tierra del Néguev, dame también fuentes de agua.» Y Caleb le dio las fuentes de arriba y las fuentes de abajo.
es.B: Ella respondió: «Hazme un regalo. Me has dado tierras en el Néguev; dame ahora también fuentes de agua.» Entonces Caleb le dio las fuentes de arriba y las fuentes de abajo.
es.R: Ella respondió: «Por favor, hazme un regalo. Me has dado tierras en el sur seco, así que dame también algunos manantiales.» Y Caleb le dio los manantiales de arriba y los de abajo.

fr.L: Et elle lui dit : « Donne-moi une bénédiction ; puisque tu m’as donné la terre du Néguev, donne-moi aussi des sources d’eau. » Et Caleb lui donna les sources d’en haut et les sources d’en bas.
fr.B: Elle répondit : « Fais-moi un cadeau. Tu m’as donné une terre dans le Néguev ; donne-moi aussi des sources d’eau. » Caleb lui donna alors les sources d’en haut et les sources d’en bas.
fr.R: Elle a répondu : « S’il te plaît, fais-moi un cadeau. Tu m’as donné une terre dans le sud, où il fait sec. Alors donne-moi aussi des sources d’eau. » Et Caleb lui a donné les sources d’en haut et celles d’en bas.

vi.L: Và nàng nói với ông: "Xin cha cho con một phước lành; vì cha đã cho con đất Nê-ghép, xin cha cũng cho con những suối nước." Và Ca-lép cho nàng các suối trên và các suối dưới.
vi.B: Nàng đáp: "Xin cha cho con một món quà. Cha đã cho con đất ở Nê-ghép, xin cha cũng cho con mấy suối nước nữa." Vậy Ca-lép cho nàng suối trên và suối dưới.
vi.R: Nàng đáp: "Xin cha cho con một món quà. Cha đã cho con đất ở miền nam khô hạn, xin cha cho con thêm mấy suối nước nữa." Vậy Ca-lép cho nàng các suối ở trên và các suối ở dưới.

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자가 그에게 말했다. "저에게 복을 주십시오. 아버지께서 저에게 네겝 땅을 주셨으니, 샘물도 저에게 주십시오." 그래서 갈렙이 그 여자에게 윗샘과 아랫샘을 주었다.
ko.B: 악사가 대답했다. "저에게 선물을 하나 주십시오. 아버지께서 저에게 네겝 땅을 주셨으니, 이제 샘물도 주십시오." 그래서 갈렙은 윗샘과 아랫샘을 딸에게 주었다.
ko.R: 악사가 대답했다. "아버지, 선물을 하나 주세요. 저에게 남쪽의 메마른 땅을 주셨으니, 샘도 몇 개 주세요." 그래서 갈렙은 윗샘과 아랫샘을 딸에게 주었다.

pt.L: E ela lhe disse: "Dê-me uma bênção; já que o senhor me deu a terra do Neguebe, dê-me também fontes de água." E Calebe lhe deu as fontes superiores e as fontes inferiores.
pt.B: Ela respondeu: "Dê-me um presente. Já que a terra que o senhor me deu fica no Neguebe, dê-me também fontes de água." Então Calebe lhe deu as fontes de cima e as fontes de baixo.
pt.R: Ela respondeu: "Por favor, dê-me um presente. O senhor me deu terra na região seca do sul, então me dê também algumas fontes de água." Então Calebe lhe deu as fontes de cima e as de baixo.

am.L: እርሷም፦ «በረከትን ስጠኝ፤ የኔጌብን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛልና የውኃ ምንጮችንም ደግሞ ስጠኝ።» አለችው። ካሌብም የላይኛውን ምንጮችና የታችኛውን ምንጮች ሰጣት።
am.B: እርሷም፦ «ስጦታ ስጠኝ። በኔጌብ ያለውን ምድር ሰጥተኸኛል፤ አሁን ደግሞ የውኃ ምንጮችን ስጠኝ።» ብላ መለሰች። ካሌብም የላይኛውንና የታችኛውን ምንጮች ሰጣት።
am.R: እርሷም፦ «እባክህ ስጦታ ስጠኝ። በደረቁ የደቡብ አገር መሬት ሰጥተኸኛል፤ ስለዚህ ጥቂት የውኃ ምንጮችም ስጠኝ።» ብላ መለሰች። ስለዚህ ካሌብ የላይኛውንና የታችኛውን ምንጮች ሰጣት።

hi.L: और उसने उससे कहा, "मुझे एक आशीष दीजिए; क्योंकि आपने मुझे नेगेव का देश दिया है, तो मुझे पानी के सोते भी दीजिए।" और कालेब ने उसे ऊपर के सोते और नीचे के सोते दे दिए।
hi.B: उसने उत्तर दिया, "मुझे एक भेंट दीजिए। आपने मुझे नेगेव में भूमि दी है, तो अब पानी के सोते भी दीजिए।" तब कालेब ने उसे ऊपर के सोते और नीचे के सोते दे दिए।
hi.R: उसने उत्तर दिया, "मुझे एक भेंट दीजिए। आपने मुझे दक्षिण की सूखी धरती दी है, तो मुझे पानी के कुछ सोते भी दीजिए।" तब कालेब ने उसे ऊपर और नीचे के सोते दे दिए।

ru.L: И сказала она ему: «Дай мне благословение: раз ты дал мне землю Негева, дай мне и источники воды.» И дал ей Халев верхние источники и нижние источники.
ru.B: Она ответила: «Сделай мне подарок. Ты дал мне землю в Негеве, дай же мне и источники воды.» И Халев дал ей верхние и нижние источники.
ru.R: Она ответила: «Пожалуйста, сделай мне подарок. Ты дал мне землю на сухом юге, так дай мне и источники воды.» И Халев дал ей верхние и нижние источники.

ja.L: そして彼女は彼に言った。「わたしに祝福をください。あなたはわたしにネゲブの地をくださったのですから、わたしに水の泉もください。」そしてカレブは彼女に上の泉と下の泉を与えた。
ja.B: 彼女は答えた。「わたしに贈り物をください。わたしにネゲブの土地をくださったのですから、今度は水の泉もください。」そこでカレブは、上の泉と下の泉を彼女に与えた。
ja.R: アクサは答えました。「どうか、わたしに贈り物をください。南の乾いた土地をくださったのですから、水の出る泉もいくつかください。」それでカレブは、上の泉と下の泉をアクサにあげました。

uk.L: І вона сказала йому: «Дай мені благословення; оскільки ти дав мені землю Негев, дай мені також джерела води.» І дав їй Калев верхні джерела і нижні джерела.
uk.B: Вона відповіла: «Дай мені дарунок. Ти дав мені землю в Негеві; дай мені тепер і джерела води.» Тоді Калев дав їй верхні джерела і нижні джерела.
uk.R: Вона відповіла: «Прошу, дай мені дарунок. Ти дав мені землю в сухому південному краї, тож дай мені й кілька джерел води.» Тож Калев дав їй верхні й нижні джерела.

decisions.choice: a blessing: a gift
decisions.reason: "Blessing" is used of a present given as a sign of goodwill (Genesis 33:11; 1 Samuel 25:27).

decisions.choice: the land of the Negev: dry land in the south
decisions.reason: The Negev is the dry south of the land, where rain is scarce. A field there was of little use without water, so she asks for springs as well.

decisions.choice: springs of water; the upper and lower springs
decisions.reason: The word is used for bowls or basins, here pools or springs of water. "The upper and the lower springs" may be the names of two groups of springs, one higher than the other (Joshua 15:19).

decisions.choice: give me also
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and you shall give me", a polite way of asking. Literal follows the wording of Joshua 15:19, the same request.

decisions.choice: the dry south country
decisions.reason: Readable says what the Negev is (m2), as in Joshua 15:19.

decisions.choice: "un cadeau" (B, R) for "a blessing"; "une bénédiction" (L)
decisions.reason: As the meaning decision says, "blessing" here means a gift. Literal keeps the Hebrew word, "une bénédiction"; Balanced and Readable say "un cadeau", the plain word a daughter would use to her father.

decisions.choice: "một phước lành" (L); "một món quà" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for blessing here means a gift (m1); Literal keeps the word, the other levels say what it is.

decisions.choice: "복" (blessing) at Literal; "선물" (gift) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for blessing here means a gift (m1); Literal keeps the word. Readable lets her speak in the softer polite style (해요체), as a daughter to her father.

decisions.choice: "በረከት" (blessing) at Literal; "ስጦታ" (gift) at Balanced and Readable.
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word, which here means a gift given as a blessing; the other levels say what she asks for.

decisions.choice: Achsah says "आप" to her father; Caleb says "तुम" to her (verse 14)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note settles, children say "आप" to a parent and the parent says "तुम".
The word is the usual one for a blessing, here meaning a gift (m1). Literal keeps "आशीष"; Balanced and Readable say "भेंट", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "благословение" (L); "подарок" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for blessing here means a gift (m1). Literal keeps the word; Balanced and Readable say what it is.

decisions.choice: "a blessing": "祝福" (L), "贈り物" (B, R); Achsah speaks politely to her father ("ください", "くださった")
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: a gift. A daughter asking her father for land speaks politely; he answers plainly.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י קֵינִי֩ חֹתֵ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה עָל֨וּ מֵעִ֤יר הַתְּמָרִים֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִדְבַּ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּנֶ֣גֶב עֲרָ֑ד וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of [the] Kenite, father-in-law of Moses, went up from [the] city of the palms with [the] sons of Judah [to the] wilderness of Judah which [is] in [the] Negev of Arad; and he went and dwelt with the people.

en.L: And the {{gender:descendants|sons}} of the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, went up from the city of palm trees with the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah [into the] wilderness of Judah, which [is] in the Negev of Arad; and he went and lived with the people.
en.B: The descendants of the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, went up with the people of Judah from the city of palm trees into the wilderness of Judah, in the Negev near Arad. They went and settled among the people.
en.R: Moses' father-in-law was a Kenite. His descendants went up with the people of Judah from Jericho, the town of palm trees, into the desert of Judah. This was in the dry south near the town of Arad. They went and settled there among the people.

sw.L: Na wana wa yule Mkeni, baba mkwe wa Musa, wakapanda kutoka mji wa mitende pamoja na wana wa Yuda [mpaka] nyika ya Yuda, iliyo katika Negebu ya Aradi; naye akaenda akakaa pamoja na watu.
sw.B: Wazao wa yule Mkeni, baba mkwe wa Musa, walipanda pamoja na watu wa Yuda kutoka mji wa mitende mpaka nyika ya Yuda, katika Negebu karibu na Aradi. Wakaenda wakakaa kati ya watu hao.
sw.R: Baba mkwe wa Musa alikuwa Mkeni. Wazao wake walipanda pamoja na watu wa Yuda kutoka Yeriko, mji wa mitende, mpaka jangwa la Yuda. Mahali hapo palikuwa katika nchi kavu ya kusini, karibu na mji wa Aradi. Wakaenda wakakaa huko kati ya watu.

es.L: Y los hijos del quenita, suegro de Moisés, subieron de la ciudad de las palmeras con los hijos de Judá [al] desierto de Judá, que [está] en el Néguev de Arad; y fue y habitó con el pueblo.
es.B: Los descendientes del quenita, el suegro de Moisés, subieron con la gente de Judá desde la ciudad de las palmeras al desierto de Judá, en el Néguev, cerca de Arad. Fueron y se establecieron entre el pueblo.
es.R: El suegro de Moisés era quenita. Sus descendientes subieron con la gente de Judá desde Jericó, la ciudad de las palmeras, al desierto de Judá. Esto era en el sur seco, cerca de la ciudad de Arad. Fueron y se establecieron allí entre el pueblo.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:descendants|fils}} du Kénien, beau-père de Moïse, montèrent de la ville des palmiers avec les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda [au] désert de Juda, qui [est] au Néguev d’Arad ; et il alla et habita avec le peuple.
fr.B: Les descendants du Kénien, beau-père de Moïse, montèrent de la ville des palmiers avec les gens de Juda jusqu’au désert de Juda, dans le Néguev, près d’Arad. Ils allèrent s’établir parmi le peuple.
fr.R: Le beau-père de Moïse était un Kénien. Ses descendants sont montés de Jéricho, la ville des palmiers, avec les gens de Juda, jusqu’au désert de Juda. C’était dans le sud, où il fait sec, près de la ville d’Arad. Ils sont allés s’installer là, parmi le peuple.

vi.L: Và con cháu của người Kê-nít, cha vợ Môi-se, đi lên từ thành cây chà là với con cái Giu-đa [vào] hoang mạc Giu-đa, ở Nê-ghép của A-rát; và ông đi và sống với dân ấy.
vi.B: Con cháu của người Kê-nít, cha vợ Môi-se, cùng với người Giu-đa đi lên từ thành cây chà là vào hoang mạc Giu-đa, tại Nê-ghép gần A-rát. Họ đến sống giữa dân ấy.
vi.R: Cha vợ của Môi-se là người Kê-nít. Con cháu ông cùng với người Giu-đa đi lên từ Giê-ri-cô, là thành cây chà là, vào hoang mạc Giu-đa. Nơi ấy ở miền nam khô hạn, gần thành A-rát. Họ đến sống giữa dân ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 모세의 장인인 겐 사람의 자손이 유다 자손과 함께 종려나무 성읍에서 아랏 남쪽 네겝에 있는 유다 광야[로] 올라갔다. 그리고 그가 가서 그 백성과 함께 살았다.
ko.B: 모세의 장인인 겐 사람의 자손은 유다 사람들과 함께 종려나무 성읍을 떠나, 아랏 근처 네겝에 있는 유다 광야로 올라갔다. 그들은 가서 그 백성 가운데 자리 잡고 살았다.
ko.R: 모세의 장인은 겐 사람이었다. 그의 자손은 유다 사람들과 함께, 종려나무 성읍인 여리고를 떠나 유다 사막으로 올라갔다. 그곳은 아랏 성읍 근처의 메마른 남쪽 땅이었다. 그들은 가서 그곳 백성 가운데 자리 잡고 살았다.

pt.L: E os filhos do queneu, sogro de Moisés, subiram da cidade das palmeiras com os filhos de Judá [ao] deserto de Judá, que [fica] no Neguebe de Arade; e ele foi e habitou com o povo.
pt.B: Os descendentes do queneu, sogro de Moisés, subiram da cidade das palmeiras com o povo de Judá para o deserto de Judá, no Neguebe, perto de Arade. Foram e se estabeleceram no meio do povo.
pt.R: O sogro de Moisés era queneu. Os descendentes dele subiram com o povo de Judá de Jericó, a cidade das palmeiras, para o deserto de Judá. Esse deserto ficava na região seca do sul, perto da cidade de Arade. Eles foram e se estabeleceram ali, no meio do povo.

am.L: የሙሴ አማት የቄናዊው ልጆችም ከይሁዳ ልጆች ጋር ከዘንባባ ዛፎች ከተማ በዓራድ ኔጌብ ወዳለው ወደ ይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሄዶም ከሕዝቡ ጋር ተቀመጠ።
am.B: የሙሴ አማት የቄናዊው ዘሮች ከይሁዳ ሕዝብ ጋር ከዘንባባ ዛፎች ከተማ በዓራድ አቅራቢያ በኔጌብ ወዳለው ወደ ይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ። ሄደውም በሕዝቡ መካከል ተቀመጡ።
am.R: የሙሴ አማት ቄናዊ ነበረ። ዘሮቹም የዘንባባ ዛፎች ከተማ ከሆነችው ከኢያሪኮ ከይሁዳ ሕዝብ ጋር ወደ ይሁዳ ምድረ በዳ ወጡ። ይህም በደቡቡ ደረቅ ምድር በዓራድ ከተማ አጠገብ ነበር። ሄደውም በዚያ በሕዝቡ መካከል ተቀመጡ።

hi.L: और केनी के, जो मूसा का ससुर था, {{gender:वंशज|पुत्र}} {{gender:यहूदा की सन्तान|यहूदा के पुत्रों}} के साथ खजूर के पेड़ों के नगर से यहूदा के निर्जन प्रदेश में, जो अराद के नेगेव में [है], चढ़ गए; और वह जाकर लोगों के साथ रहने लगा।
hi.B: मूसा के ससुर केनी के वंशज यहूदा के लोगों के साथ खजूर के पेड़ों के नगर से यहूदा के निर्जन प्रदेश में चढ़ गए, जो अराद के पास नेगेव में है। वे जाकर उन लोगों के बीच बस गए।
hi.R: मूसा का ससुर केनी जाति का था। उसके वंशज यहूदा के लोगों के साथ खजूर के पेड़ों के नगर यरीहो से यहूदा के सुनसान इलाक़े में चले गए। यह जगह दक्षिण के सूखे प्रदेश में अराद नगर के पास थी। वे जाकर वहाँ के लोगों के बीच बस गए।

ru.L: И {{gender:потомки|сыновья}} кенеянина, тестя Моисея, поднялись из города пальм с {{gender:детьми Иуды|сынами Иуды}} [в] пустыню Иуды, которая в Негеве Арада; и он пошёл и поселился с народом.
ru.B: Потомки кенеянина, тестя Моисея, поднялись вместе с людьми Иуды из города пальм в пустыню Иуды, в Негев близ Арада. Они пришли и поселились среди народа.
ru.R: Тесть Моисея был кенеянином. Его потомки поднялись вместе с людьми Иуды из Иерихона, города пальм, в пустыню Иуды. Это было на сухом юге, недалеко от города Арада. Они пришли туда и поселились среди народа.

ja.L: そしてモーセのしゅうとであるケニ人の子らは、ユダの子らと共になつめやしの町から、アラドのネゲブにあるユダの荒れ野に上った。そして彼は行って、民と共に住んだ。
ja.B: モーセのしゅうとであったケニ人の子孫は、ユダの人々と共になつめやしの町から上って、アラドの近くのネゲブにあるユダの荒れ野に来た。彼らは行って、その民の中に住みついた。
ja.R: モーセのしゅうとはケニ人でした。その子孫は、なつめやしの町エリコから、ユダの人々と一緒にユダの荒れ野へ上って行きました。そこは南の乾いた地方で、アラドという町の近くでした。彼らはそこへ行って、その民の中に住みつきました。

uk.L: І {{gender:нащадки|сини}} кенійця, тестя Мойсея, пішли з Міста пальм з {{gender:нащадками Юди|синами Юди}} [у] пустелю Юди, що [в] Негеві Араду; і він пішов і оселився з народом.
uk.B: Нащадки кенійця, тестя Мойсея, пішли разом з народом Юди з Міста пальм у пустелю Юди, у Негеві біля Араду. Вони пішли й оселилися серед народу.
uk.R: Тесть Мойсея був кенійцем. Його нащадки пішли разом з народом Юди з Єрихона, Міста пальм, у пустелю Юди. Це було на сухому півдні біля міста Арад. Вони пішли й оселилися там серед народу.

decisions.choice: the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law: a desert people joined to Israel by marriage
decisions.reason: The Kenites were a desert clan linked with Midian (Numbers 10:29-32; 24:21). Moses' father-in-law is called a Kenite again in 4:11, where he is named Hobab. His family came into the land with Israel, as Moses had promised them a share in its good (Numbers 10:32).

decisions.choice: the city of palm trees: Jericho
decisions.reason: Jericho is called "the city of palm trees" in Deuteronomy 34:3 and 2 Chronicles 28:15. The Kenites had camped near it and now move south with Judah.

decisions.choice: the Kenite ... the people: the Hebrew has no name for the father-in-law and says only "the people"
alternatives: the Kenite, Hobab, father-in-law of Moses
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives no name for Moses' father-in-law here. Some copies of the ancient Greek translation add a name, and some read "Amalek" in place of "the people", so that the Kenites settle among the Amalekites, as 1 Samuel 15:6 later finds them. The Hebrew is followed. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: he went and lived: the Kenite clan as one
decisions.reason: The verbs are singular, speaking of the whole Kenite family as one person, as Judah is spoken of in verse 3.

decisions.choice: They went and settled
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "they" for the singular "he" (m4).

decisions.choice: Jericho, the town of palm trees; the dry south
decisions.reason: Readable names the city (m2) and says what the Negev is.

decisions.choice: "thành cây chà là"; Readable adds "Giê-ri-cô"
decisions.reason: The city of palm trees is Jericho (m2); Readable names it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: o queneu, os queneus; a cidade das palmeiras; Arade
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 4:11, 17; 5:24): "queneu" is the form of Genesis 15:19 in Portuguese, and "Arade" that of Numbers 21:1. "Os filhos do queneu" (L) needs no gender setting: "filhos" already takes in daughters, and Balanced and Readable say "descendentes", as the English default does.

decisions.choice: No gender span on "ልጆች" or "ዘሮች" for the Kenite's descendants.
decisions.reason: "ልጆች" and "ዘሮች" already take in sons and daughters, so Amharic has only one wording here.

decisions.choice: "descendants of the Kenite": "ケニ人の子ら" (L), "ケニ人の子孫" (B, R), with no gender span; "the city of palm trees" "なつめやしの町" (R adds "エリコ")
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Japanese "子ら" and "子孫" include men and women. Meaning decision m2: the city of palm trees is Jericho, which Readable names as the English does.

decisions.choice: "кенієць", "кенійці" for the Kenite
decisions.reason: A people's name formed as "кенізієць" in Joshua; "Місто пальм" keeps Jericho's byname.

source.text: וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־שִׁמְע֣וֹן אָחִ֔יו וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב צְפַ֑ת וַיַּחֲרִ֣ימוּ אוֹתָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִ֖יר חָרְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Judah with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanite[s] dwelling [in] Zephath, and they devoted it to destruction; and called [one] [the] name of the city Hormah.

en.L: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who lived [in] Zephath, and they devoted it to destruction; and [one] called the name of the city Hormah.
en.B: Then Judah went with his brother Simeon, and they defeated the Canaanites who lived in Zephath. They devoted the city to destruction, so it was named Hormah.
en.R: Then the people of Judah went with the people of Simeon, and they defeated the Canaanites who lived in the town of Zephath. They destroyed it completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. So the town was called Hormah, which means "Destruction."

sw.L: Naye Yuda akaenda pamoja na Simeoni ndugu yake, wakawapiga Wakanaani waliokaa [katika] Sefathi, wakauweka wakfu kwa maangamizi; na [mtu] akaliita jina la mji huo Horma.
sw.B: Kisha Yuda alikwenda pamoja na Simeoni ndugu yake, wakawashinda Wakanaani waliokaa Sefathi. Waliuweka mji huo wakfu kwa maangamizi, kwa hiyo ukaitwa Horma.
sw.R: Kisha watu wa Yuda walikwenda pamoja na watu wa Simeoni, wakawashinda Wakanaani walioishi katika mji wa Sefathi. Waliuangamiza kabisa, kama mji uliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa hiyo mji huo ukaitwa Horma, maana yake "Maangamizi."

es.L: Y fue Judá con Simeón su hermano, e hirieron a los cananeos que habitaban [en] Sefat, y la consagraron al exterminio; y se llamó el nombre de la ciudad Horma.
es.B: Luego Judá fue con su hermano Simeón, y derrotaron a los cananeos que vivían en Sefat. Consagraron la ciudad al exterminio, y por eso se le dio el nombre de Horma.
es.R: Luego la gente de Judá fue con la gente de Simeón, y derrotaron a los cananeos que vivían en la ciudad de Sefat. La destruyeron por completo, como algo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Por eso la ciudad se llamó Horma, que significa «Destrucción».

fr.L: Et Juda alla avec Siméon son frère, et ils frappèrent les Cananéens qui habitaient [à] Tsephath, et ils la vouèrent à l’interdit ; et on appela le nom de la ville Horma.
fr.B: Puis Juda partit avec son frère Siméon, et ils battirent les Cananéens qui habitaient Tsephath. Ils vouèrent la ville à l’interdit, et c’est pourquoi on l’appela Horma.
fr.R: Ensuite, les hommes de Juda sont partis avec ceux de Siméon, et ils ont battu les Cananéens qui vivaient dans la ville de Tsephath. Ils l’ont entièrement détruite, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. C’est pourquoi on a appelé la ville Horma, ce qui veut dire « Destruction ».

vi.L: Và Giu-đa đi với Si-mê-ôn, anh mình, và họ đánh người Ca-na-an sống [tại] Xê-phát, và họ tận diệt thành; và người ta gọi tên thành là Họt-ma.
vi.B: Rồi Giu-đa đi với Si-mê-ôn, anh mình, và họ đánh bại người Ca-na-an sống tại Xê-phát. Họ tận diệt thành ấy, nên thành được gọi là Họt-ma.
vi.R: Rồi người Giu-đa đi với người Si-mê-ôn và đánh bại người Ca-na-an sống tại thành Xê-phát. Họ hủy diệt hoàn toàn thành ấy, như dâng trọn cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vì vậy thành được gọi là Họt-ma, nghĩa là "Hủy Diệt".

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 그의 형제 시므온과 함께 가서 스밧에 사는 가나안 사람들을 쳤고, 그것을 진멸하였다. 그리고 [사람들이] 그 성읍의 이름을 호르마라고 불렀다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 유다는 자기 형제 시므온과 함께 가서 스밧에 사는 가나안 사람들을 쳐부수었다. 그들이 그 성을 진멸했으므로 그 성은 호르마라고 불리게 되었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 유다 사람들은 시므온 사람들과 함께 가서 스밧 성읍에 사는 가나안 사람들을 무찔렀다. 그들은 그 성읍을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치는 것으로 여겨 완전히 멸했다. 그래서 그 성읍은 '멸망'이라는 뜻의 호르마라고 불렸다.

pt.L: E Judá foi com Simeão, seu irmão, e feriram os cananeus que habitavam [em] Zefate, e a consagraram à destruição; e chamaram o nome da cidade Hormá.
pt.B: Depois Judá foi com o seu irmão Simeão, e derrotaram os cananeus que moravam em Zefate. Consagraram a cidade à destruição, e por isso ela recebeu o nome de Hormá.
pt.R: Depois o povo de Judá foi com o povo de Simeão, e eles derrotaram os cananeus que moravam na cidade de Zefate. Destruíram a cidade completamente, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Por isso a cidade foi chamada Hormá, que quer dizer "Destruição".

am.L: ይሁዳም ከወንድሙ ከስምዖን ጋር ሄደ፤ በጸፋት የሚኖሩትንም ከነዓናውያን መቱ፤ ለጥፋትም ለዩአት፤ የከተማዪቱም ስም ሔርማ ተብሎ ተጠራ።
am.B: ከዚያም ይሁዳ ከወንድሙ ከስምዖን ጋር ሄዶ በጸፋት የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ድል አደረጉ። ከተማዪቱንም ለጥፋት ለዩአት፤ ስለዚህ ሔርማ፣ ማለትም ጥፋት ተባለች።
am.R: ከዚያም የይሁዳ ሰዎች ከስምዖን ሰዎች ጋር ሄደው በጸፋት ከተማ የሚኖሩትን ከነዓናውያን ድል አደረጉ። ከተማዪቱንም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} እንደ ተሰጠች ቆጥረው ፈጽመው አጠፏት። ስለዚህ ከተማዪቱ ሔርማ ተባለች፤ ትርጉሙም «ጥፋት» ማለት ነው።

hi.L: और यहूदा अपने भाई शिमोन के साथ गया, और उन्होंने सपत में रहनेवाले कनानियों को मारा, और उसे सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित कर दिया; और उस नगर का नाम होर्मा रखा गया।
hi.B: फिर यहूदा अपने भाई शिमोन के साथ गया, और उन्होंने सपत में रहनेवाले कनानियों को हरा दिया। उन्होंने उस नगर को सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित कर दिया, इसलिए उसका नाम होर्मा पड़ा।
hi.R: फिर यहूदा के लोग शिमोन के लोगों के साथ गए, और उन्होंने सपत नगर में रहनेवाले कनानियों को हरा दिया। उन्होंने उस नगर को {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अर्पित मानकर पूरी तरह नाश कर दिया। इसलिए उस नगर का नाम होर्मा पड़ा, जिसका अर्थ है "सर्वनाश।"

ru.L: И пошёл Иуда с Симеоном, своим братом, и поразили они хананеев, живших [в] Цефате, и предали его заклятию; и назвали имя города Хорма.
ru.B: Потом Иуда пошёл вместе со своим братом Симеоном, и они разбили хананеев, живших в Цефате. Они предали город заклятию, и поэтому его назвали Хорма.
ru.R: Потом люди из колена Иуды пошли вместе с людьми из колена Симеона и разбили хананеев, которые жили в городе Цефате. Они полностью уничтожили его, отдав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Поэтому этот город назвали Хорма, что значит «Уничтожение.»

ja.L: そしてユダは兄弟シメオンと共に行った。彼らはツェファトに住むカナン人を打ち、それを滅ぼし尽くした。そして人はその町の名をホルマと呼んだ。
ja.B: それからユダは兄弟シメオンと共に行き、ツェファトに住むカナン人を打ち破った。彼らはその町を滅ぼし尽くしたので、町はホルマと名づけられた。
ja.R: それから、ユダの人々はシメオンの人々と一緒に行って、ツェファトという町に住むカナン人を打ち負かしました。彼らはその町を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にささげたものとして完全に滅ぼしました。それで、その町はホルマ、つまり「全滅」と呼ばれるようになりました。

uk.L: І пішов Юда з Симеоном, своїм братом, і побили ханаанеїв, що жили [в] Цефаті, і віддали його на знищення; і назвали імʼя міста Горма.
uk.B: Тоді Юда пішов зі своїм братом Симеоном, і вони розбили ханаанеїв, що жили в Цефаті. Вони віддали місто на знищення, тож його назвали Горма.
uk.R: Тоді люди Юди пішли з людьми Симеона і розбили ханаанеїв, що жили в місті Цефат. Вони повністю знищили його, віддавши {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}. Тож місто назвали Горма, що означає «Знищення».

decisions.choice: devoted it to destruction: gave the city wholly to God by destroying it
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of things or people given over to the LORD and taken out of human use, here by destroying them (Deuteronomy 7:2; Joshua 6:17-21).

decisions.choice: Hormah: a name made from the verb "devote to destruction"
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the verb and can be heard as "Destruction" or "Devoted place". Numbers 21:1-3 tells of Israel devoting the towns of this region and naming the place Hormah; here Zephath is taken and given the name. Hormah later counts among Simeon's towns (Joshua 19:4), so Judah keeps its promise to Simeon (verse 3).

decisions.choice: called: the naming is impersonal
decisions.reason: "He called" has no named subject and means "the city was called", as in Numbers 21:3.

decisions.choice: as given over to the LORD; which means "Destruction"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term, as in Joshua, and gives the sense of the name so that the reader can hear how it links with the destruction.

decisions.choice: "kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi" (L, B); "kuangamiza kabisa, kama mji uliotolewa kwa BWANA" (R), for the verb of devoting to destruction, through these chapters
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb means to give a city wholly to God by destroying it. Swahili "kuweka wakfu" is to dedicate, and "kwa maangamizi" says how, as the Pentateuch drafts do; Readable says plainly that the city was destroyed and why, as the English Readable does. The name Horma is then explained as "Maangamizi" (Destruction).

decisions.choice: "consagrar al exterminio" (L, B); "destruir por completo, como algo entregado al SEÑOR" (R)
alternatives: "consagrar a la destrucción", as in Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as the terms note for these books sets: the verb means giving a city wholly to God by destroying it (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the religious sense with "consagrar al exterminio"; Readable says plainly what happened and why, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "vouer à l'interdit" (L, B); "détruire entièrement, comme une chose donnée au SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10, as the terms note sets for *herem*: the city was given wholly to God by being destroyed, and "vouer à l'interdit" is the French phrase for that act; Readable says what happened in plain words, as the English Readable does. The name Horma comes from the same verb, which Readable explains.

decisions.choice: "tận diệt" (L, B); "hủy diệt hoàn toàn, như dâng trọn cho CHÚA" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the Hebrew herem verb: to give a city wholly to God by destroying it (m1). Readable explains it, as the English Readable does, and gives the meaning of the name Hormah (m2).

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" (L, B) and "완전히 멸하다" (R) for *haram*, devoting to destruction
alternatives: "전멸하다", which loses the sense of giving over to God
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for Joshua and Judges. "진멸" is the word Korean readers know for this; Readable says plainly that the city was destroyed completely as given to God.

decisions.choice: consagrar à destruição (L, B); destruir completamente, como coisa entregue ao SENHOR (R); Hormá, que quer dizer "Destruição" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verb of the ban (m1) keeps the wording Deuteronomy and Joshua 2:10 use in Portuguese. The name keeps the form and the Readable gloss of Numbers 21:3 in Portuguese, the story this verse echoes (m2). "Zefate" is the Brazilian form of Zephath.

decisions.choice: Ḥerem is "ለጥፋት ለዩአት" (Literal, Balanced); Readable says that the city was counted as given to the LORD and destroyed completely. Hormah is "ሔርማ", as Numbers 14:45; 21:3, and Balanced and Readable explain it as "ጥፋት" (Balanced without quotation marks, so that its quotations stay those of the English).
decisions.reason: As in Numbers and Deuteronomy, "ለጥፋት መለየት" keeps the sense of a thing set apart to God by destruction; the name Hormah comes from the same verb, which an Amharic reader cannot hear.

decisions.choice: "सर्वनाश के लिए अर्पित कर देना" (herem)
decisions.reason: As Numbers 21:3, where the same name Hormah is given: the city is given wholly to God by being destroyed (m1), so the Hindi keeps both the giving and the destroying. Readable says it in plainer words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "предать заклятию" (L, B); "полностью уничтожить, отдав ГОСПОДУ" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 21:3 and Deuteronomy 7:2: the Hebrew verb means to give a thing wholly to God by destroying it (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the traditional "предать заклятию"; Readable says what it meant, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: cherem "滅ぼし尽くした" (L, B), "主にささげたものとして完全に滅ぼしました" (R, with the divine_name span as in the English); Hormah explained in Readable as "「全滅」"
decisions.reason: As Joshua and Deuteronomy in Japanese ("聖絶" is not used); meaning decision m2: the name is made from the verb.

source.text: וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת־עַזָּ֣ה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָ֔הּ וְאֶֽת־אַשְׁקְל֖וֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָ֑הּ וְאֶת־עֶקְר֖וֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And captured Judah Gaza and its territory, and Ashkelon and its territory, and Ekron and its territory.

en.L: And Judah captured Gaza and its territory, and Ashkelon and its territory, and Ekron and its territory.
en.B: Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron, each with its surrounding territory.
en.R: Judah also captured the towns of Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron, and the land around each of them.

sw.L: Naye Yuda akatwaa Gaza na mpaka wake, na Ashkeloni na mpaka wake, na Ekroni na mpaka wake.
sw.B: Yuda pia aliteka Gaza, Ashkeloni na Ekroni, kila mmoja pamoja na eneo lililouzunguka.
sw.R: Watu wa Yuda pia waliteka miji ya Gaza, Ashkeloni na Ekroni, pamoja na nchi iliyozunguka kila mji.

es.L: Y tomó Judá Gaza y su territorio, y Ascalón y su territorio, y Ecrón y su territorio.
es.B: Judá también tomó Gaza, Ascalón y Ecrón, cada una con el territorio que la rodeaba.
es.R: Judá también conquistó las ciudades de Gaza, Ascalón y Ecrón, y las tierras alrededor de cada una.

fr.L: Et Juda prit Gaza et son territoire, et Ashkelon et son territoire, et Ekron et son territoire.
fr.B: Juda prit aussi Gaza, Ashkelon et Ekron, chacune avec son territoire.
fr.R: Les hommes de Juda ont aussi pris les villes de Gaza, d’Ashkelon et d’Ekron, avec les terres autour de chacune d’elles.

vi.L: Và Giu-đa chiếm Ga-xa và địa phận của nó, và Ách-ca-lôn và địa phận của nó, và Éc-rôn và địa phận của nó.
vi.B: Giu-đa cũng chiếm Ga-xa, Ách-ca-lôn và Éc-rôn, cùng với vùng đất chung quanh mỗi thành.
vi.R: Giu-đa cũng chiếm các thành Ga-xa, Ách-ca-lôn và Éc-rôn, cùng với vùng đất chung quanh mỗi thành.

ko.L: 그리고 유다가 가사와 그 지역과 아스글론과 그 지역과 에그론과 그 지역을 점령하였다.
ko.B: 유다는 또 가사와 아스글론과 에그론을, 각각 그 주변 지역과 함께 점령했다.
ko.R: 유다는 또 가사와 아스글론과 에그론 성읍을 점령하고, 그 성읍들 주변 땅도 차지했다.

pt.L: E Judá tomou Gaza e o seu território, e Ascalom e o seu território, e Ecrom e o seu território.
pt.B: Judá também tomou Gaza, Ascalom e Ecrom, cada uma com o território ao seu redor.
pt.R: Judá também tomou as cidades de Gaza, Ascalom e Ecrom, e as terras em volta de cada uma delas.

am.L: ይሁዳም ጋዛንና ግዛቷን፣ አስቀሎንንና ግዛቷን፣ አቃሮንንና ግዛቷን ያዘ።
am.B: ይሁዳ ደግሞ ጋዛን፣ አስቀሎንንና አቃሮንን ከየአካባቢያቸው ግዛት ጋር ያዘ።
am.R: ይሁዳ ደግሞ የጋዛን፣ የአስቀሎንንና የአቃሮንን ከተሞች በዙሪያቸው ካለው ምድር ጋር ያዘ።

hi.L: और यहूदा ने गाज़ा और उसका क्षेत्र, और अश्कलोन और उसका क्षेत्र, और एक्रोन और उसका क्षेत्र ले लिया।
hi.B: यहूदा ने गाज़ा, अश्कलोन और एक्रोन को भी, और हर एक के आसपास के क्षेत्र को ले लिया।
hi.R: यहूदा ने गाज़ा, अश्कलोन और एक्रोन नगरों को, और उनमें से हर एक के आसपास की ज़मीन को भी जीत लिया।

ru.L: И взял Иуда Газу и её пределы, и Аскалон и его пределы, и Аккарон и его пределы.
ru.B: Иуда взял также Газу, Аскалон и Аккарон с окрестными землями каждого из них.
ru.R: Колено Иуды захватило также города Газу, Аскалон и Аккарон и земли вокруг каждого из них.

ja.L: そしてユダはガザとその領域、アシュケロンとその領域、エクロンとその領域を攻め取った。
ja.B: ユダはまた、ガザ、アシュケロン、エクロンを、それぞれ周りの地域と共に攻め取った。
ja.R: ユダは、ガザとアシュケロンとエクロンの町も取りました。それぞれの町の周りの土地も取りました。

uk.L: І захопив Юда Газу та її територію, і Ашкелон та його територію, і Екрон та його територію.
uk.B: Юда захопив також Газу, Ашкелон і Екрон, кожне з навколишньою територією.
uk.R: Юда захопив також міста Газу, Ашкелон і Екрон і землі довкола кожного з них.

decisions.choice: Judah captured: the Hebrew text followed
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads that Judah "did not take" Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron. That fits verse 19, where Judah cannot drive out the people of the plain, and the later chapters, where these cities are Philistine strongholds (3:3; 14:19; 16:1). The Hebrew says they were captured, which may mean they were taken for a time but not held. The Hebrew is followed. This note is from general knowledge of the Greek and should be checked by a reviewer.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Ashkelon, Ekron: cities of the southern coastal plain
decisions.reason: These are three of the five cities later held by the Philistines (Joshua 13:3). Joshua 15:45-47 lists them in Judah's land.

decisions.choice: each with its surrounding territory (B); the land around each of them (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "its territory" once for the three cities; Literal keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: Gaza, Ascalom, Ecrom
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 14:19; 16:1-21): the Brazilian forms of the three Philistine cities (m2), "Ascalom" as Joshua 13:3 and "Ecrom" as Joshua 19:43 have them in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶתּ־יְהוּדָ֔הוַיֹּ֖רֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָ֑ר כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְהוֹרִישׁ֙ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָעֵ֔מֶק כִּי־רֶ֥כֶב בַּרְזֶ֖ל לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And was Yahweh with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country; for not to dispossess [the] inhabitants of the valley, for chariotry of iron [was] to them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with Judah, and he took possession of the hill country; but [he could] not dispossess the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was with Judah, and they took the hill country for their own. But they could not drive out the people who lived on the plain, because those people had iron chariots.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was with the people of Judah, and they took over the hill country. But they could not drive out the people who lived on the plain, because those people had chariots made with iron.

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa pamoja na Yuda, naye akaimiliki nchi ya milima; lakini [hakuweza] kuwafukuza wenyeji wa bondeni, kwa sababu walikuwa na magari ya chuma.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa pamoja na watu wa Yuda, nao wakaimiliki nchi ya milima. Lakini hawakuweza kuwafukuza watu waliokaa nchi tambarare, kwa sababu watu hao walikuwa na magari ya vita ya chuma.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa pamoja na watu wa Yuda, nao wakaitwaa nchi ya milima. Lakini hawakuweza kuwafukuza watu walioishi katika nchi tambarare, kwa sababu watu hao walikuwa na magari ya vita yaliyotengenezwa kwa chuma.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con Judá, y tomó posesión de la región montañosa; pero no [pudo] desposeer a los habitantes del valle, porque tenían carros de hierro.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con Judá, y ellos se adueñaron de la región montañosa. Pero no pudieron expulsar a los que vivían en la llanura, porque aquella gente tenía carros de hierro.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con la gente de Judá, y ellos se apoderaron de la región montañosa. Pero no pudieron expulsar a los que vivían en la llanura, porque aquella gente tenía carros de guerra reforzados con hierro.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec Juda, et il prit possession de la montagne ; mais [il ne put] pas déposséder les habitants de la vallée, car ils avaient des chars de fer.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec Juda, qui prit possession de la région montagneuse. Mais il ne put pas chasser les habitants de la plaine, parce qu’ils avaient des chars de fer.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec les hommes de Juda, et ils ont pris la région des collines. Mais ils n’ont pas pu chasser les gens qui vivaient dans la plaine, parce que ces gens avaient des chars garnis de fer.

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Giu-đa, và họ chiếm lấy vùng đồi núi; nhưng [họ không thể] đuổi dân cư của thung lũng đi, vì chúng có xe chiến bằng sắt.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Giu-đa, và họ chiếm được vùng đồi núi. Nhưng họ không thể đuổi dân cư ở đồng bằng đi, vì dân ấy có xe chiến bằng sắt.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với người Giu-đa, và họ chiếm được vùng đồi núi. Nhưng họ không đuổi được dân sống ở đồng bằng, vì dân ấy có xe chiến được bọc sắt.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다와 함께 계셨으므로 그가 산지를 차지하였다. 그러나 골짜기의 주민들은 쫓아내지 못하였다. 그들에게 철 병거가 있었기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다와 함께 계셨으므로, 그들은 산지를 차지했다. 그러나 평지에 사는 사람들은 쫓아내지 못했다. 그 사람들에게는 철 병거가 있었기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 사람들과 함께 계셨으므로, 그들은 산지를 차지했다. 그러나 평지에 사는 사람들은 쫓아내지 못했다. 그 사람들에게는 쇠로 만든 전차가 있었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} estava com Judá, e ele tomou posse da região montanhosa; mas [não pôde] desapossar os habitantes do vale, porque eles tinham carros de ferro.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} estava com Judá, e eles se apossaram da região montanhosa. Mas não conseguiram expulsar os moradores da planície, porque eles tinham carros de ferro.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} estava com o povo de Judá, e eles tomaram a região das montanhas. Mas não conseguiram expulsar os moradores da planície, porque eles tinham carros de guerra reforçados com ferro.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ከይሁዳ ጋር ነበረ፤ ኮረብታማውንም አገር ወረሰ፤ የሸለቆውን ነዋሪዎች ግን ማስወጣት [አልቻለም]፤ የብረት ሰረገሎች ነበሯቸውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከይሁዳ ጋር ነበረ፤ እነርሱም ኮረብታማውን አገር የራሳቸው አደረጉ። ነገር ግን በሜዳው የሚኖሩት ሰዎች የብረት ሰረገሎች ስለ ነበሯቸው ሊያስወጧቸው አልቻሉም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከይሁዳ ሕዝብ ጋር ነበረ፤ እነርሱም ኮረብታማውን አገር ያዙ። ነገር ግን በሜዳው የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች ማስወጣት አልቻሉም፤ እነዚያ ሰዎች በብረት የተለበጡ ሰረገሎች ነበሯቸውና።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा के साथ थे, और उसने पहाड़ी देश पर अधिकार कर लिया; परंतु वह घाटी के निवासियों को बेदख़ल न [कर सका], क्योंकि उनके पास लोहे के रथ थे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा के साथ थे, और उन्होंने पहाड़ी देश को अपना बना लिया। परंतु वे मैदान में रहनेवालों को नहीं निकाल सके, क्योंकि उन लोगों के पास लोहे के रथ थे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा के लोगों के साथ थे, और उन्होंने पहाड़ी इलाक़े पर क़ब्ज़ा कर लिया। पर वे मैदान में रहनेवाले लोगों को नहीं निकाल पाए, क्योंकि उन लोगों के पास ऐसे रथ थे जिनमें लोहा लगा था।

ru.L: И был {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} с Иудой, и он овладел горной страной; но не [мог] изгнать жителей долины, потому что у них [были] железные колесницы.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} был с Иудой, и они овладели горами. Но жителей равнины они не смогли изгнать, потому что у тех были железные колесницы.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} был с людьми Иуды, и они завладели горами. Но тех, кто жил на равнине, они не смогли прогнать, потому что у них были колесницы, окованные железом.

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はユダと共におられた。彼は山地を所有した。しかし、谷の住民を追い払うことはできなかった。彼らが鉄の戦車を持っていたからである。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はユダと共におられ、ユダは山地を自分のものとした。しかし、平地に住む人々を追い払うことはできなかった。その人々が鉄の戦車を持っていたからである。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はユダの人々と共におられました。ユダの人々は山地を自分たちのものにしました。でも、平地に住む人々を追い出すことはできませんでした。その人々は、鉄で補強した戦車を持っていたからです。

uk.L: І був {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} з Юдою, і він посів гори; але [не міг] вигнати мешканців долини, бо в них були залізні колесниці.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} був з Юдою, і вони заволоділи горами. Але вони не змогли вигнати жителів рівнини, бо в тих були залізні колесниці.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} був з народом Юди, і вони заволоділи горами. Але вони не змогли вигнати людей, що жили на рівнині, бо в тих були колесниці, оковані залізом.

decisions.choice: not to dispossess: was not able to drive them out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "not to dispossess", a short way of saying it could not be done (compare Joshua 17:12, "were not able to take possession").

decisions.choice: chariots of iron: war chariots fitted with iron
decisions.reason: As at Joshua 17:16, these were horse-drawn war chariots, probably made of wood with iron fittings. On flat ground they gave the Canaanites the advantage; in the hills they were of little use.

decisions.choice: the LORD was with Judah, yet they could not drive out the people of the plain
decisions.reason: The verse sets the two side by side without explaining them. In Joshua 17:18 Joshua had told Joseph's tribes that they would drive out the Canaanites "though they have iron chariots". The book goes on to give the LORD's own word on why the nations remained (2:1-3, 20-23).

decisions.choice: the valley: the low, flat land below the hills
decisions.reason: The word means a broad valley or plain. Here it is the lowland beside Judah's hills, most likely the coastal plain of verse 18.

decisions.choice: drive out; the plain
decisions.reason: For peoples, Literal says "dispossess" and Balanced and Readable "drive out", as in Joshua. Balanced and Readable say "plain" for the flat land meant (m4); Literal keeps "valley".

decisions.choice: "kuwafukuza" (drive out) for the verb of dispossessing a people, at every level, through these chapters; "kumiliki" (take possession) for taking land
decisions.reason: The one Hebrew verb means both to take possession of land and to drive out the people who held it. Swahili has no single word for both, so it says "kuimiliki nchi" of the land and "kuwafukuza" of the people, at every level, as the Deuteronomy drafts do.

decisions.choice: "desposeer" (L); "expulsar" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges: the verb means to take the land by driving its people out. Literal keeps "desposeer", the verb's legal sense, as the English Literal keeps "dispossess"; Balanced and Readable say "expulsar", as the English says "drive out".

decisions.choice: "déposséder" (L); "chasser" (B, R) for the verb *yarash* applied to peoples
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10, as the English: Literal keeps the legal sense of the verb, to take possession by removing the owners, with "déposséder"; Balanced and Readable say "chasser", which is what it meant in practice. Where the land itself is the object, the verb is "prendre possession de".

decisions.choice: "đuổi ... đi" for the verb "dispossess"
decisions.reason: The verb means to drive a people out and take their land (m1); "đuổi" is kept at every level through the list of this chapter, so the reader can see the same failure repeated.

decisions.choice: desapossar (L); expulsar (B, R); carros de ferro (L, B), carros de guerra reforçados com ferro (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (the list of verses 19-33 and 2:3, 21, 23): for peoples, Literal says "desapossar" and Balanced and Readable "expulsar", as Joshua 15:14 and 15:63 have it in Portuguese. "Carros" with "de ferro" or "de guerra" is the Portuguese word for chariots (m2), as Joshua 11:4; Readable says what iron had to do with them, as the English "made with iron" does.

decisions.choice: "बेदख़ल करना" (L); "निकालना", "निकाल देना" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy, Literal says "बेदख़ल करना" for the verb of taking the land from its people (yarash), and Balanced and Readable say "निकालना" (drive out), as the English does. This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "изгнать" (L, B); "прогнать" (R), through the chapter's list of towns
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, the Hebrew "dispossess" (to drive a people out and take its land) is "изгнать" at Literal and Balanced, as in Numbers and Deuteronomy, and the plainer "прогнать" at Readable. The verse says they could not (m1): Literal supplies "мог" in brackets.

decisions.choice: yarash: "所有した" (L), "自分のものとした" (B, R) for taking the hill country; the hiphil "dispossess" "追い払う" (L, B), "追い出す" (R) through chapter 1
decisions.reason: The forms Deuteronomy uses for the two stems of the verb, so the repeated "did not drive out" of 1:21-33 reads as one refrain.

decisions.choice: "chariots of iron": "鉄の戦車" (L, B), "鉄で補強した戦車" (R); "the valley" "谷" (L), "平地" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decisions m2 and m4: war chariots fitted with iron; the low flat land.

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ לְכָלֵב֙ אֶת־חֶבְר֔וֹן כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י הָעֲנָֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: And they gave to Caleb Hebron just as had spoken Moses, and he dispossessed from there [the] three sons of the Anak.

en.L: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, just as Moses had said, and he dispossessed from there the three sons of Anak.
en.B: Hebron was given to Caleb, as Moses had promised, and he drove out the three sons of Anak from there.
en.R: As Moses had promised, Caleb was given the town of Hebron. Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak who lived there.

sw.L: Nao wakampa Kalebu Hebroni, kama Musa alivyosema; naye akawafukuza kutoka huko wana watatu wa Anaki.
sw.B: Kalebu alipewa Hebroni, kama Musa alivyoahidi, naye akawafukuza kutoka huko wana watatu wa Anaki.
sw.R: Kama Musa alivyokuwa ameahidi, Kalebu alipewa mji wa Hebroni. Kalebu aliwafukuza wana watatu wa Anaki walioishi huko.

es.L: Y dieron a Caleb Hebrón, tal como había dicho Moisés, y desposeyó de allí a los tres hijos de Anac.
es.B: Hebrón se le dio a Caleb, como Moisés había prometido, y él expulsó de allí a los tres hijos de Anac.
es.R: Como Moisés lo había prometido, a Caleb le dieron la ciudad de Hebrón. Caleb expulsó a los tres hijos de Anac que vivían allí.

fr.L: Et ils donnèrent Hébron à Caleb, comme Moïse l’avait dit, et il déposséda de là les trois fils d’Anaq.
fr.B: On donna Hébron à Caleb, comme Moïse l’avait promis, et il en chassa les trois fils d’Anaq.
fr.R: Comme Moïse l’avait promis, Caleb a reçu la ville d’Hébron. Caleb a chassé de là les trois fils d’Anaq qui y vivaient.

vi.L: Và họ trao Hếp-rôn cho Ca-lép, đúng như Môi-se đã nói; và ông đuổi ba con trai của A-nác ra khỏi đó.
vi.B: Hếp-rôn được trao cho Ca-lép như Môi-se đã hứa, và ông đuổi ba con trai của A-nác ra khỏi đó.
vi.R: Như Môi-se đã hứa, Ca-lép được nhận thành Hếp-rôn. Ca-lép đuổi ba con trai của A-nác đang sống ở đó đi.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 모세가 말한 대로 헤브론을 갈렙에게 주었고, 그가 거기서 아낙의 세 아들을 쫓아냈다.
ko.B: 모세가 약속한 대로 헤브론은 갈렙에게 주어졌고, 갈렙은 거기서 아낙의 세 아들을 쫓아냈다.
ko.R: 모세가 약속한 대로 갈렙은 헤브론 성읍을 받았다. 갈렙은 거기 살던 아낙의 세 아들을 쫓아냈다.

pt.L: E deram Hebrom a Calebe, como Moisés tinha dito, e ele desapossou dali os três filhos de Anaque.
pt.B: Hebrom foi dada a Calebe, como Moisés tinha prometido, e ele expulsou dali os três filhos de Anaque.
pt.R: Como Moisés tinha prometido, Calebe recebeu a cidade de Hebrom. Calebe expulsou os três filhos de Anaque que viviam lá.

am.L: ሙሴም እንደ ተናገረ ኬብሮንን ለካሌብ ሰጡት፤ ከዚያም ሦስቱን የዔናቅ ልጆች አስወጣ።
am.B: ሙሴ ቃል እንደ ገባው ኬብሮን ለካሌብ ተሰጠች፤ እርሱም ሦስቱን የዔናቅ ልጆች ከዚያ አስወጣ።
am.R: ሙሴ ቃል እንደ ገባው የኬብሮን ከተማ ለካሌብ ተሰጠች። ካሌብም በዚያ ይኖሩ የነበሩትን ሦስቱን የዔናቅ ልጆች አስወጣ።

hi.L: और उन्होंने हेब्रोन कालेब को दिया, जैसा मूसा ने कहा था; और उसने वहाँ से अनाक के तीन पुत्रों को बेदख़ल किया।
hi.B: जैसा मूसा ने वचन दिया था, हेब्रोन कालेब को दिया गया, और उसने वहाँ से अनाक के तीनों पुत्रों को निकाल दिया।
hi.R: जैसा मूसा ने वादा किया था, हेब्रोन नगर कालेब को दिया गया। कालेब ने वहाँ रहनेवाले अनाक के तीनों पुत्रों को निकाल दिया।

ru.L: И дали Халеву Хеврон, как говорил Моисей, и он изгнал оттуда трёх сыновей Енака.
ru.B: Хеврон отдали Халеву, как и обещал Моисей, и он изгнал оттуда трёх сыновей Енака.
ru.R: Как и обещал Моисей, Халев получил город Хеврон. Халев прогнал оттуда трёх сыновей Енака, которые там жили.

ja.L: そして彼らはモーセが語ったとおり、カレブにヘブロンを与えた。そして彼はそこからアナクの三人の子らを追い払った。
ja.B: モーセが約束したとおり、ヘブロンはカレブに与えられた。カレブはそこからアナクの三人の息子を追い払った。
ja.R: モーセが約束したとおり、カレブはヘブロンの町をもらいました。カレブは、そこに住んでいたアナクの三人の息子を追い出しました。

uk.L: І дали Калевові Хеврон, як сказав Мойсей, і він вигнав звідти трьох синів Анака.
uk.B: Хеврон дали Калевові, як обіцяв Мойсей, і він вигнав звідти трьох синів Анака.
uk.R: Як обіцяв Мойсей, Калевові дали місто Хеврон. Калев вигнав трьох синів Анака, що жили там.

decisions.choice: just as Moses had said: the promise to Caleb
decisions.reason: Moses had promised Caleb the land he walked on as a scout, because he followed the LORD fully (Numbers 14:24; Deuteronomy 1:36), and Joshua gave him Hebron on that word (Joshua 14:9-14).

decisions.choice: the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai
decisions.reason: These are the three named in verse 10 and Joshua 15:14. "Sons" may mean their clans as well.

decisions.choice: they gave: the giver is not named
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject; Joshua 14:13 and 15:13 tell that Joshua gave Hebron to Caleb.

decisions.choice: was given; drove out
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a passive so as not to name a giver the Hebrew does not name (m3), as in Joshua 15:13. For "drive out" see verse 19.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹ֥א הוֹרִ֖ישׁוּ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the Jebusite[s] dwelling [in] Jerusalem not dispossessed [the] sons of Benjamin; and dwelt the Jebusite[s] with [the] sons of Benjamin in Jerusalem until the day the this.

en.L: But the Jebusites who lived [in] Jerusalem, the {{gender:children|sons}} of Benjamin did not dispossess [them]; and the Jebusites have lived with the {{gender:children|sons}} of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
en.B: But the people of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem, and the Jebusites have lived there with the people of Benjamin to this day.
en.R: But the people of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem. The Jebusites still live there among the people of Benjamin today.

sw.L: Lakini Wayebusi waliokaa [katika] Yerusalemu, wana wa Benyamini hawakuwafukuza; nao Wayebusi wamekaa pamoja na wana wa Benyamini katika Yerusalemu mpaka siku hii.
sw.B: Lakini watu wa Benyamini hawakuwafukuza Wayebusi waliokaa Yerusalemu, na Wayebusi wamekaa huko pamoja na watu wa Benyamini mpaka leo.
